units.zh: 成皇帝諱衍，字世根，明帝長子也。
units.en: Emperor Cheng, personal name Yan, courtesy name Shigen, was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.
units.literal: The taboo name of Emperor Cheng was Yan, his courtesy name Shigen, and he was the eldest son of Emperor Ming.

units.zh: 太寧三年三月戊辰，立爲皇太子。
units.en: On the wuchen day of the third month in the third year of the Taining era (325 CE), he was invested as crown prince.
units.literal: In the third year of Taining, third month, day wuchen, he was established as heir apparent.

units.zh: 閏月戊子，明帝崩。
units.en: On the wuzi day of the intercalary month, Emperor Ming died.
units.literal: Intercalary month, day wuzi, Emperor Ming died.

units.zh: 己丑，太子卽皇帝位，大赦，增文武位二等，賜鰥寡孤老帛，人二匹，尊皇后庾氏爲皇太后。
units.en: On the jichou day the crown prince ascended the throne. He declared a general amnesty, promoted civil and military officials by two ranks, gave two bolts of silk each to widowers, widows, orphans, and the elderly, and elevated Empress Yu to the title of empress dowager.
units.literal: Day jichou, the crown prince assumed the imperial throne, a general amnesty was proclaimed, civil and military ranks were raised two grades, widowers, widows, orphans, and the aged were granted silk, two bolts per person, and Empress Yu was honored as empress dowager.

units.zh: 秋九月癸卯，皇太后臨朝稱制。
units.en: In autumn, on the guimao day of the ninth month, the empress dowager began to rule from behind the screen as regent.
units.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day guimao, the empress dowager attended court and assumed regency.

units.zh: 司徒王導錄尚書事，與中書令庾亮參輔朝政。
units.en: Wang Dao, minister of education, was placed in charge of the Masters of Writing, while Palace Secretariat director Yu Liang joined him in steering the affairs of state.
units.literal: Minister of Education Wang Dao recorded affairs of the Masters of Writing, and together with Director of the Palace Secretariat Yu Liang participated in assisting court government.

units.zh: 以撫軍將軍、南頓王宗爲驃騎將軍，領軍將軍、汝南王祐爲衛將軍。
units.en: Prince Zong of Nandun, general who comforts the army, was appointed general of agile cavalry; Prince You of Runan, general who commands the army, was appointed general of the guard.
units.literal: The General Who Comforts the Army, Prince of Nandun Zong, was made General of Agile Cavalry; the General Who Commands the Army, Prince of Runan You, was made General of the Guard.

units.zh: 辛丑，葬明帝於武平陵。
units.en: On the xinchou day Emperor Ming was laid to rest at the Wuping imperial mausoleum.
units.literal: Day xinchou, Emperor Ming was buried at Wuping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 冬十一月癸巳朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: In winter, the new moon fell on guisi in the eleventh month and a solar eclipse was observed.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, first day guisi, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 廣陵相曹渾有罪，下獄死。
units.en: Cao Hun, chancellor of Guangling, was found guilty, imprisoned, and died there.
units.literal: Chancellor of Guangling Cao Hun had a crime, was cast into prison and died.

units.zh: 咸和元年春二月丁亥，大赦，改元，大酺五日，賜鰥寡孤老米，二人斛，京師百里內復一年。
units.en: In spring of the first year of the Xianhe era (326), on the dinghai day of the second month, the court proclaimed a general amnesty, adopted the new reign title, ordered five days of public feasting, distributed rice to widowers, widows, orphans, and the elderly at the rate of one hu for every two persons, and remitted one year of taxes and labor service within a hundred li of the capital.
units.literal: First year of Xianhe, spring, second month, day dinghai, general amnesty, changed era name, great feast for five days, granted rice to widowers, widows, orphans, and aged, two persons one hu, within one hundred li of the capital remitted one year.

units.zh: 夏四月，石勒遣其將石生寇汝南，汝南人執內史祖濟以叛。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, Shi Le of Later Zhao sent his general Shi Sheng against Runan; the people of Runan seized their interior secretary, Zu Ji, and rose in revolt.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Shi Le sent his general Shi Sheng to raid Runan, and Runan people seized Interior Secretary Zu Ji in rebellion.

units.zh: 甲子，尚書左僕射鄧攸卒。
units.en: On the jiazi day Deng You, left vice director of the Masters of Writing, died.
units.literal: Day jiazi, Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Deng You died.

units.zh: 五月，大水。
units.en: In the fifth month severe flooding struck.
units.literal: Fifth month, great flood.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，使持節、散騎常侍、監淮北諸軍事、北中郎將、徐州刺史、泉陵公劉遐卒。
units.en: On the guihai day of the sixth month Liu Xia, duke of Quanling—holder of the insignia of authority, cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, supervisor of all forces north of the Huai, General of the North Gentlemen of the Household, and inspector of Xuzhou—passed away.
units.literal: Sixth month, day guihai, Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Supervisor of Military Affairs North of the Huai, General of the North Gentlemen of the Household, Inspector of Xuzhou, Duke of Quanling Liu Xia died.

units.zh: 癸酉，以車騎將軍郗鑒領徐州刺史，征虜將軍郭默爲北中郎將、假節、監淮北諸軍。
units.en: On the guiyou day Xi Jian, general of chariots and cavalry, was ordered to take charge of Xuzhou as well, while Guo Mo, general who conquers the caitiffs, was named General of the North Gentlemen of the Household, granted the credential staff, and put in command of the armies north of the Huai.
units.literal: Day guiyou, Chariots and Cavalry General Xi Jian was appointed to concurrent duty as Inspector of Xuzhou, General Who Conquers the Caitiffs Guo Mo was made General of the North Gentlemen of the Household, given credential staff, and supervisor of military affairs north of the Huai.

units.zh: 劉遐部曲將李龍、史迭奉遐子肇代遐位以距默，臨淮太守劉矯擊破之，斬龍，傳首京師。
units.en: Two of Liu Xia's client generals, Li Long and Shi Die, set up Liu Xia's son Zhao in his father's place to oppose Guo Mo. Liu Jiao, administrator of Linhuai, crushed their force, executed Li Long, and forwarded his head to the capital.
units.literal: Liu Xia's subordinate generals Li Long and Shi Die supported Liu Xia's son Zhao to replace Liu Xia's position in order to resist Guo Mo; Administrator of Linhuai Liu Jiao attacked and defeated them, beheaded Long, and sent the head to the capital.

units.zh: 秋七月癸丑，使持節、都督江州諸軍事、江州刺史、平南將軍、觀陽伯應詹卒。
units.en: In autumn, on the guichou day of the seventh month, Ying Zhan, baron of Guanyang—credential-bearing area commander for Jiangzhou, inspector of Jiangzhou, and general who pacifies the south—died.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guichou, Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Area Commander-in-Chief for military affairs of Jiangzhou, Inspector of Jiangzhou, General Who Pacifies the South, Baron of Guanyang Ying Zhan died.

units.zh: 八月，以給事中、前將軍、丹陽尹溫嶠爲平南將軍、假節、都督，江州刺史。
units.en: In the eighth month Wen Qiao—palace assistant, general of the van, and governor of Danyang—was promoted to general who pacifies the south, granted the credential staff, and named area commander and inspector of Jiangzhou.
units.literal: Eighth month, Palace Assistant, General of the Van, Governor of Danyang Wen Qiao was made General Who Pacifies the South, given credential staff, area commander, Inspector of Jiangzhou.

units.zh: 九月，旱。
units.en: The ninth month brought drought.
units.literal: Ninth month, drought.

units.zh: 李雄將張龍寇涪陵，執太守謝俊。
units.en: Zhang Long, a general under Cheng's Li Xiong, struck Fuling and took the prefect, Xie Jun, prisoner.
units.literal: Li Xiong's general Zhang Long raided Fuling and seized Administrator Xie Jun.

units.zh: 冬十月，封魏武帝玄孫曹勵爲陳留王，以紹魏。
units.en: Winter, tenth month: Cao Li, a descendant of Emperor Wu of Wei, was made prince of Chenliu to continue the Wei line.
units.literal: In winter, the tenth month, Cao Li, great-great-grandson of Emperor Wu of Wei, was enfeoffed as Prince of Chenliu to continue the line of Wei.

units.zh: 丙寅，衛將軍、汝南王祐薨。
units.en: On bingyin, Prince You of Runan, Guards General, died.
units.literal: On bingyin, You, Prince of Runan and Guards General, died.

units.zh: 己巳，封皇弟岳爲吳王。
units.en: On jisi, the emperor made his younger brother Yue prince of Wu.
units.literal: On jisi, the emperor's younger brother Yue was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu.

units.zh: 車騎將軍、南頓王宗有罪，伏誅，貶其族爲馬氏。
units.en: Zong, Prince of Nandun and General of Chariots and Cavalry, was convicted and executed, and his lineage was reduced to the Ma surname.
units.literal: Zong, Prince of Nandun and General of Chariots and Cavalry, was guilty of a crime and was executed; his clan was demoted to the Ma surname.

units.zh: 免太宰、西陽王羕，降爲弋陽縣王。
units.en: Yang, Prince of Xiyang and Grand Steward, was removed and demoted to prince of Yiyang county.
units.literal: Yang, Prince of Xiyang and Grand Steward, was dismissed and demoted to Prince of Yiyang county.

units.zh: 庚辰，赦百里內五歲以下刑。
units.en: On gengchen, sentences of five years and below were pardoned within a hundred li.
units.literal: On gengchen, within a hundred li, punishments of five years and below were pardoned.

units.zh: 是月，劉曜將黃秀、帛成寇酂，平北將軍魏該帥衆奔襄陽。
units.en: That month, Liu Yao's generals Huang Xiu and Bo Cheng raided Zan, and Wei Gai, General Who Pacifies the North, fled with his followers to Xiangyang.
units.literal: That month, Liu Yao's generals Huang Xiu and Bo Cheng raided Zan; Wei Gai, General Who Pacifies the North, led his followers in flight to Xiangyang.

units.zh: 十一月壬子，大閱于南郊。
units.en: On the renzi day of the eleventh month the emperor held a grand military review at the southern suburban altar.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day renzi, great review at the southern suburb.

units.zh: 改定王侯國秩，九分食一。
units.en: The stipends of princely fiefs were revised so that each noble drew only one-ninth of the commandery's revenue.
units.literal: Changed and fixed princes' and marquises' state stipends, nine parts eat one.

units.zh: 石勒將石聰攻壽陽，不克，遂侵逡遒、阜陵。
units.en: Shi Cong, Shi Le's general, failed to take Shouyang but pushed on to raid Qunqiu and Fuling.
units.literal: Shi Le's general Shi Cong attacked Shouyang, did not overcome, then invaded Qunqiu and Fuling.

units.zh: 加司徒王導大司馬、假黃鉞、都督中外征討諸軍事以禦之。
units.en: Wang Dao, minister of education, was further named grand marshal, given the yellow battle-ax, and placed in supreme command of all forces at home and in the field to meet the threat.
units.literal: Minister of Education Wang Dao was additionally given Grand Marshal, yellow battle-ax, area commander of all central and outer campaign and punitive military affairs in order to resist him.

units.zh: 歷陽太守蘇峻遣其將韓晃討石聰，走之。
units.en: Su Jun, administrator of Liyang, dispatched Han Huang against Shi Cong and drove him off.
units.literal: Administrator of Liyang Su Jun sent his general Han Huang to punish Shi Cong and routed him.

units.zh: 時大旱，自六月不雨，至於是月。
units.en: A severe drought had gripped the realm: no rain had fallen since the sixth month down to this point.
units.literal: At that time great drought, from sixth month no rain, until this month.

units.zh: 十二月，濟㟭太守劉闓殺下邳內史夏侯嘉，叛降石勒。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liu Kai, administrator of the Jimin commandery, murdered Xiahou Jia, interior secretary of Xiapi, and defected with his command to Shi Le.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Administrator of Jimin Liu Kai killed Interior Secretary of Xiapi Xiahou Jia, rebelled and surrendered to Shi Le.

units.zh: 梁王翹薨。
units.en: Prince Qiao of Liang died.
units.literal: Prince of Liang Qiao died.

units.zh: 二年春正月，甯州秀才龐遺起義兵，攻李雄將任回、李謙等，雄遣其將羅恆、費黑救之。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the second year of Xianhe (327), Pang Yi, a provincial graduate of Ningzhou, raised loyalist forces against Li Xiong's generals Ren Hui and Li Qian. Li Xiong countered by sending Luo Heng and Fei Hei to their relief.
units.literal: Second year spring first month, Ningzhou recommended scholar Pang Yi raised righteous troops, attacked Li Xiong's generals Ren Hui, Li Qian, etc., Xiong sent his generals Luo Heng, Fei Hei to rescue them.

units.zh: 寧州刺史尹奉遣裨將姚岳、朱提太守楊術援遺，戰於臺登，岳等敗績，術死之。
units.en: Yin Feng, inspector of Ningzhou, sent Yao Yue and Yang Shu, administrator of Zhuti, to reinforce Pang Yi. They fought at Taideng; Yao Yue's men were routed and Yang Shu was killed.
units.literal: Inspector of Ningzhou Yin Feng sent subordinate general Yao Yue, Administrator of Zhuti Yang Shu to aid Yi, battled at Taideng, Yue and others were defeated, Shu died in it.

units.zh: 三月，益州地震。
units.en: In the third month an earthquake shook Yizhou.
units.literal: Third month, Yizhou earthquake.

units.zh: 夏四月，旱。
units.en: Drought persisted through the fourth month of summer.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.

units.zh: 己未，豫章地震。
units.en: On the jiwei day Yuzhang was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: Day jiwei, Yuzhang earthquake.

units.zh: 五月甲申朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: The new moon on jiashen in the fifth month coincided with a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Fifth month, first day jiashen, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 丙戌，加豫州刺史祖約爲鎮西將軍。
units.en: On the bingxu day Zu Yue, inspector of Yuzhou, received the additional title of general who guards the west.
units.literal: Day bingxu, added Inspector of Yuzhou Zu Yue as General Who Guards the West.

units.zh: 戊子，京師大水。
units.en: On the wuzi day catastrophic flooding hit the capital.
units.literal: Day wuzi, capital great flood.

units.zh: 冬十月，劉曜使其子胤侵枹罕，遂略河南地。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Liu Yao of Former Zhao dispatched his son Yin against Fuhan and went on to overrun the country south of the Yellow River.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Liu Yao sent his son Yin to invade Fuhan, then plundered Henan territory.

units.zh: 十一月，豫州刺史祖約、歷陽太守蘇峻等反。
units.en: In the eleventh month Zu Yue, inspector of Yuzhou, Su Jun, administrator of Liyang, and their confederates rose in rebellion.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Inspector of Yuzhou Zu Yue, Administrator of Liyang Su Jun and others rebelled.

units.zh: 十二月辛亥，蘇峻使其將韓晃入姑孰，屠于湖。
units.en: On the xinhai day of the twelfth month Su Jun sent Han Huang into Gushu, where his troops massacred the population at Yu Lake.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai, Su Jun sent his general Han Huang to enter Gushu, slaughtered at Yu Lake.

units.zh: 壬子，彭城王雄、章武王休叛，奔峻。
units.en: On the renzi day Princes Xiong of Pengcheng and Xiu of Zhangwu broke with the court and fled to Su Jun's camp.
units.literal: Day renzi, Prince of Pengcheng Xiong, Prince of Zhangwu Xiu rebelled, fled to Jun.

units.zh: 庚申，京師戒嚴。
units.en: On the gengshen day the capital was placed under martial law.
units.literal: Day gengshen, capital martial law.

units.zh: 假護軍將軍庾亮節爲征討都督，以右衛將軍趙胤爲冠軍將軍、歷陽太守，使與左將軍司馬流帥師距峻，戰於慈湖，流敗，死之。
units.en: Yu Liang, guard general, was given the credential staff as campaign commander-in-chief. Zhao Yin, right guard general, was named champion general and administrator of Liyang and, with Sima Liu, left general, sent to block Su Jun. They met the rebels at Cihu; Sima Liu was defeated and killed.
units.literal: Yu Liang, Guard General, was granted the ceremonial staff as campaign commander-in-chief; Right Guard General Zhao Yin was made Champion General and Administrator of Liyang and, together with Left General Sima Liu, ordered to lead troops to resist Jun; they battled at Cihu; Liu was defeated and died in that battle.

units.zh: 假驍騎將軍鐘雅節，帥舟軍，與趙胤爲前鋒，以距峻。
units.en: Zhong Ya, agile cavalry general, received the staff of command and led the riverine force as van alongside Zhao Yin to hold Su Jun at bay.
units.literal: Agile Cavalry General Zhong Ya was granted the ceremonial staff and led the boat army, with Zhao Yin as the van, in order to resist Jun.

units.zh: 丙寅，徒封琅邪王昱爲會稽王，吳王岳爲琅邪王。
units.en: On the bingyin day Prince Yu of Langye was reassigned as prince of Kuaiji, while Prince Yue of Wu was transferred to the Langye princedom.
units.literal: Day bingyin, moved enfeoffment Prince of Langye Yu to Prince of Kuaiji, Prince of Wu Yue to Prince of Langye.

units.zh: 辛未，宣城內桓彝及峻戰于蕪湖，彝軍敗績。
units.en: On the xinwei day Huan Yi, interior secretary of Xuancheng, fought Su Jun at Wuhu and suffered a crushing defeat.
units.literal: Day xinwei, Xuancheng interior Huan Yi and Jun battled at Wuhu, Yi's army was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 軍騎將軍郗鑒遣廣陵相劉矩帥師赴京師。
units.en: Xi Jian, general of chariots and cavalry, ordered Liu Ju, chancellor of Guangling, to march a relief column to the capital.
units.literal: Army Cavalry General Xi Jian sent Chancellor of Guangling Liu Ju to lead troops to hasten to the capital.

units.zh: 三年春正月，平南將軍溫嶠帥師救京師，次於尋陽，遣督護王愆期、西陽太守鄧嶽、鄱陽太守紀睦爲前鋒。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the third year of Xianhe (328), Wen Qiao, general who pacifies the south, led troops to relieve the capital and halted at Xunyang, dispatching Wang Yanqi, Deng Yue of Xiyang, and Ji Mu of Poyang as his vanguard commanders.
units.literal: Third year spring first month, General Who Pacifies the South Wen Qiao led troops to rescue the capital, halted at Xunyang, sent Supervisor Wang Yanqi, Administrator of Xiyang Deng Yue, and Administrator of Poyang Ji Mu as van.

units.zh: 征西大將軍陶侃遣督護龔登受嶠節度。
units.en: Tao Kan, grand general who conquers the west, sent his supervisor Gong Deng to serve under Wen Qiao's command.
units.literal: General Who Conquers the West Grand General Tao Kan sent Supervisor Gong Deng to receive Qiao's direction.

units.zh: 鐘雅、趙胤等次慈湖，王愆期、鄧嶽等次直瀆。
units.en: Zhong Ya and Zhao Yin drew up at Cihu, while Wang Yanqi and Deng Yue encamped at Zhidu.
units.literal: Zhong Ya, Zhao Yin and others halted at Cihu, Wang Yanqi, Deng Yue and others halted at Zhidu.

units.zh: 丁未，峻濟自橫江，登牛渚。
units.en: On the dingwei day Su Jun's army crossed at Hengjiang and climbed onto the Niuzhu shore.
units.literal: Day dingwei, Jun crossed from Hengjiang, ascended Niuzhu.

units.zh: 二月庚戌，峻至于蔣山。
units.en: On the gengxu day of the second month Su Jun reached Mount Jiang.
units.literal: Second month, day gengxu, Jun arrived at Jiangshan.

units.zh: 假領軍將軍卞壼節，帥六軍，及峻戰于西陵，王師敗績。
units.en: Bian Kun, general who commands the army, took the credential staff, led the six imperial armies against Su Jun at Xiling, and was routed.
units.literal: General Who Commands the Army Bian Kun was granted the ceremonial staff, led the six armies, and battled Jun at Xiling; the royal army was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 丙辰，峻攻青溪柵，因風縱火，王師又大敗。
units.en: On the bingchen day Su Jun stormed the Qingxi palisade and, using a favoring wind, set it ablaze; the imperial forces suffered another catastrophic defeat.
units.literal: Day bingchen, Jun attacked Qingxi stockade, following wind set fire, royal army again was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 尚書令、領軍將軍卞壼，丹陽尹羊曼，黃門侍郎周導，廬江太守陶瞻並遇害，死者數千人。
units.en: Bian Kun, director of the Masters of Writing and general who commands the army; Yang Man, governor of Danyang; Zhou Dao, gentleman attendant at the yellow gate; and Tao Zhan, administrator of Lujiang, were all killed, along with several thousand others.
units.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing, General Who Commands the Army Bian Kun, Governor of Danyang Yang Man, Gentleman Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhou Dao, Administrator of Lujiang Tao Zhan together met harm, dead numbered several thousand.

units.zh: 庾亮又敗于宣陽門內，遂攜其諸弟與郭默、趙胤奔尋陽。
units.en: Yu Liang was beaten again inside Xuanyang Gate and fled to Xunyang with his brothers, Guo Mo, and Zhao Yin.
units.literal: Yu Liang again was defeated inside Xuanyang Gate, then carried his various younger brothers with Guo Mo, Zhao Yin fled to Xunyang.

units.zh: 於是司徒王導、右光祿大夫陸曄、荀崧等衛帝於太極殿，太常孔愉守宗廟。
units.en: Wang Dao, minister of education, Lu Ye and Xun Song, senior grandees of splendid carriage on the right, and others shielded the emperor in the Taiji Hall while Kong Yu, minister of ceremonies, held the imperial shrines.
units.literal: Thereupon Minister of Education Wang Dao, Right Grand Master of Splendid Carriage Lu Ye, Xun Song and others guarded the emperor at Taiji Hall, Minister of Ceremonies Kong Yu guarded the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 賊乘勝麾戈接於帝座，突入太后後宮，左右侍人皆見掠奪。
units.en: The rebels pressed their advantage: weapons were brandished within reach of the throne, they broke into the empress dowager's private quarters, and every attendant within was robbed.
units.literal: Rebels riding victory waved spears touching the emperor's seat, burst into empress dowager's rear palace, left and right attendants all were seen plundered.

units.zh: 是時太官唯有燒余米數石，以供御膳。
units.en: The imperial kitchen could scrape together only a few shi of scorched leftover grain for the sovereign's table.
units.literal: At this time the Grand Provisioner only had several shi of burnt remaining rice, in order to supply imperial meals.

units.zh: 百姓號泣，響震都邑。
units.en: The people of the capital wailed until their cries shook the city.
units.literal: Hundred surnames wailed and wept, sound shook capital and towns.

units.zh: 丁巳，峻矯詔大赦，又以祖約爲侍中、太尉、尚書令，自爲驃騎將軍、錄尚書事。
units.en: On the dingsi day Su Jun forged an edict of general amnesty, named Zu Yue palace attendant, grand commandant, and director of the Masters of Writing, and took for himself the posts of general of agile cavalry and overseer of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Day dingsi, Jun forged edict great amnesty, again made Zu Yue Palace Attendant, Grand Commandant, Director of the Masters of Writing, himself was General of Agile Cavalry, recorded Masters of Writing affairs.

units.zh: 吳郡太守庾冰奔于會稽。
units.en: Yu Bing, administrator of Wu commandery, fled east to Kuaiji.
units.literal: Administrator of Wu Commandery Yu Bing fled to Kuaiji.

units.zh: 三月丙子，皇太后庾氏崩。
units.en: On the bingzi day of the third month Empress Dowager Yu died.
units.literal: Third month, day bingzi, Empress Dowager Yu died.

units.zh: 夏四月，石勒攻宛，南陽太守王國叛，降於勒。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Shi Le besieged Wan. Wang Guo, administrator of Nanyang, rebelled and went over to him.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Shi Le attacked Wan, Administrator of Nanyang Wang Guo rebelled, surrendered to Le.

units.zh: 壬申，葬明穆皇后于武平陵。
units.en: On the renshen day Empress Mingmu was interred at the Wuping mausoleum.
units.literal: Day renshen, buried Empress Mingmu at Wuping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 五月乙未，峻逼遷天子于石頭，帝哀泣升車，宮中慟哭。
units.en: On the yiwei day of the fifth month Su Jun forced the emperor to relocate to his stronghold at Stone Fort; the emperor wept as he boarded the cart, and lamentation filled the palace.
units.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei, Jun forced moved Son of Heaven to Stone Fort, emperor sorrowfully wept ascending carriage, inside palace greatly wept.

units.zh: 峻以倉屋爲宮，遣管商、張瑾、弘徽寇晉陵，韓晃寇義興。
units.en: Su Jun quartered the court in granary sheds and dispatched Guan Shang, Zhang Jin, and Hong Hui against Jinling while Han Huang struck Yixing.
units.literal: Jun used granary buildings as palace, sent Guan Shang, Zhang Jin, Hong Hui to raid Jinling, Han Huang to raid Yixing.

units.zh: 吳興太守虞潭與庚冰、王舒等起義兵于三吳。
units.en: Yu Tan, administrator of Wuxing, joined Yu Bing, Wang Shu, and others in raising loyalist forces across the Wu region.
units.literal: Administrator of Wuxing Yu Tan with Geng Bing, Wang Shu and others raised righteous troops in Three Wu.

units.zh: 丙午，征西大將軍陶侃、平南將軍溫嶠、護軍將軍庾亮、平北將軍魏該舟軍四萬，次于蔡洲。
units.en: On the bingwu day Tao Kan, grand general who conquers the west; Wen Qiao, general who pacifies the south; Yu Liang, guard general; and Wei Gai, general who pacifies the north, brought forty thousand men by river and anchored at Caizhou.
units.literal: Day bingwu, General Who Conquers the West Grand General Tao Kan, General Who Pacifies the South Wen Qiao, Guard General Yu Liang, General Who Pacifies the North Wei Gai boat army forty thousand, halted at Caizhou.

units.zh: 六月，韓晃攻宣城，內史桓彝力戰，死之。
units.en: In the sixth month Han Huang attacked Xuancheng. Huan Yi, the interior secretary, fought to the last and was killed.
units.literal: Sixth month, Han Huang attacked Xuancheng, Interior Secretary Huan Yi forcefully battled, died in it.

units.zh: 壬辰，平北將軍、雍州刺史魏該卒于師。
units.en: On the renchen day Wei Gai, general who pacifies the north and inspector of Yongzhou, died in camp with the expeditionary army.
units.literal: Day renchen, General Who Pacifies the North, Inspector of Yongzhou Wei Gai died in army.

units.zh: 廬江太守毛寶攻賊合肥戍，拔之。
units.en: Mao Bao, administrator of Lujiang, stormed the rebel outpost at Hefei and took it.
units.literal: Administrator of Lujiang Mao Bao attacked rebels' Hefei garrison, uprooted it.

units.zh: 秋七月，祖約爲石勒將石聰所攻，衆潰，奔于歷陽。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Zu Yue was shattered by an attack from Shi Cong, one of Shi Le's generals, and fled with the survivors to Liyang.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Zu Yue was attacked by Shi Le's general Shi Cong, crowd collapsed, fled to Liyang.

units.zh: 石勒將石季龍攻劉曜於蒲阪。
units.en: Shi Hu (Shi Jilong), a general of Shi Le, opened an offensive against Liu Yao at Puban.
units.literal: Shi Le's general Shi Jilong attacked Liu Yao at Puban.

units.zh: 八月，曜及石季龍戰于高候，季龍敗績，曜遂圍石生于洛陽。
units.en: In the eighth month Liu Yao met Shi Hu at Gaohou and broke his army, then invested Shi Sheng at Luoyang.
units.literal: Eighth month, Yao and Shi Jilong battled at Gaohou, Jilong was greatly defeated, Yao then besieged Shi Sheng at Luoyang.

units.zh: 九月戊申，司徒王導奔于白石。
units.en: On the wushen day of the ninth month Wang Dao, minister of education, withdrew to the Baishi encampment.
units.literal: Ninth month, day wushen, Minister of Education Wang Dao fled to Baishi.

units.zh: 庚午，陶侃使督護楊謙攻峻于石頭。
units.en: On the gengwu day Tao Kan ordered Yang Qian, his supervisor of troops, to strike Su Jun at Stone Fort.
units.literal: Day gengwu, Tao Kan sent Supervisor Yang Qian to attack Jun at Stone Fort.

units.zh: 溫嶠、庾亮陣于白石，竟陵太守李陽距賊南偏。
units.en: Wen Qiao and Yu Liang drew up their lines at Baishi while Li Yang, administrator of Jingling, held the southern sector against the rebels.
units.literal: Wen Qiao, Yu Liang arrayed at Baishi, Administrator of Jingling Li Yang resisted rebels' southern flank.

units.zh: 峻輕騎出戰，墜馬，斬之，衆遂大潰。
units.en: Su Jun sortied with a small cavalry escort, was thrown from his horse, and was cut down; his army then dissolved in panic.
units.literal: Jun light cavalry went out to battle, fell from horse, beheaded him, crowd then greatly collapsed.

units.zh: 賊黨復立峻弟逸爲帥。
units.en: The rebel remnant raised Su Jun's brother Su Yi to lead them.
units.literal: Rebel faction again established Jun's younger brother Yi as commander.

units.zh: 前交州刺史張璉據始興反，進攻廣州，鎮南司馬曾勰等擊破之。
units.en: Zhang Lian, former inspector of Jiaozhou, seized Shixing in revolt and marched on Guangzhou until Zeng Xie, major on the staff of the defender of the south, and others shattered his force.
units.literal: Former Inspector of Jiaozhou Zhang Lian occupied Shixing rebelled, advanced attacked Guangzhou, Defender of the South Major Zeng Xie and others attacked defeated them.

units.zh: 冬十月，李雄將張龍寇涪陵，太守趙弼于於賊。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Zhang Long, a general of Li Xiong, again raided Fuling; Zhao Bi, the prefect, perished in the fighting against the bandits.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Li Xiong's general Zhang Long raided Fuling; Administrator Zhao Bi died at the hands of the rebels (text defective).

units.zh: 十二月乙未，石勒敗劉曜于洛陽，獲之。
units.en: On the yiwei day of the twelfth month Shi Le defeated Liu Yao at Luoyang and took him prisoner.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day yiwei, Shi Le defeated Liu Yao at Luoyang, captured him.

units.zh: 是歲，石勒將石季龍攻氐帥蒲洪於隴山，降之。
units.en: That same year Shi Hu, serving Shi Le, struck the Di leader Pu Hong in the Long range and forced his submission.
units.literal: This year, Shi Le's general Shi Jilong attacked Di chieftain Pu Hong at Longshan, made him surrender.

units.zh: 四年春正月，帝在石頭，賊將匡術以苑城歸順，百官赴焉。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the fourth year of Xianhe (329), while the emperor remained at Stone Fort, the rebel general Kuang Shu surrendered the Yuan walled park, and the court officials flocked there.
units.literal: Fourth year spring first month, emperor was at Stone Fort, rebel general Kuang Shu with Yuan City submitted, hundred officials went there.

units.zh: 侍中鐘雅、右衛將軍劉超謀奉帝出，爲賊所害。
units.en: Zhong Ya, palace attendant, and Liu Chao, right guard general, plotted to spirit the emperor away and were murdered by the rebels.
units.literal: Palace Attendant Zhong Ya, Right Guard General Liu Chao plotted to carry emperor out, were harmed by rebels.

units.zh: 戊辰，冠軍將軍趙胤遣將甘苗討祖約于歷陽，敗之，約奔于石勒，其將牽騰帥衆降。
units.en: On the wuchen day Zhao Yin, champion general, sent Gan Miao against Zu Yue at Liyang, broke his army, and drove Zu Yue to seek refuge with Shi Le; Zu Yue's general Qian Teng capitulated with his troops.
units.literal: Day wuchen, Champion General Zhao Yin sent general Gan Miao to punish Zu Yue at Liyang, defeated him, Yue fled to Shi Le, his general Qian Teng led crowd to surrender.

units.zh: 峻子碩攻臺城，又焚太極東堂、秘閣，皆盡。
units.en: Su Shuo, Su Jun's son, assaulted the terrace city and burned the eastern hall of the Taiji complex and the imperial library to ashes.
units.literal: Jun's son Shuo attacked terrace city, again burned Taiji east hall, secret pavilion, all exhausted.

units.zh: 城中大饑，米斗萬錢。
units.en: Famine gripped the city: a peck of rice cost ten thousand cash.
units.literal: Inside city great famine, rice dou ten thousand cash.

units.zh: 二月，大雨霖。
units.en: In the second month the rains fell without cease.
units.literal: Second month, great rain continuous.

units.zh: 丙戌，諸軍攻石頭。
units.en: On the bingxu day the allied armies stormed Stone Fort.
units.literal: Day bingxu, various armies attacked Stone Fort.

units.zh: 李陽與蘇逸戰於柤浦，陽軍敗。
units.en: Li Yang clashed with Su Yi at Zhapu and was defeated.
units.literal: Li Yang and Su Yi battled at Zhapu, Yang's army was defeated.

units.zh: 建威長史滕含以銳卒擊之，逸等大敗。
units.en: Teng Han, chief clerk on the staff of the general who establishes might, counterattacked with picked troops and shattered Su Yi and his men.
units.literal: General Who Establishes Might Chief Clerk Teng Han with sharp soldiers struck them, Yi and others were greatly defeated.

units.zh: 含奉帝御于溫嶠舟，羣臣頓首號泣請罪。
units.en: Teng Han escorted the imperial palanquin aboard Wen Qiao's ship, where the ministers kowtowed, weeping, and begged forgiveness.
units.literal: Han carried emperor's carriage to Wen Qiao's boat, group ministers knocked head wailed requesting guilt.

units.zh: 弋陽王羕有罪，伏誅。
units.en: Prince Yang of Yiyang was found guilty and executed.
units.literal: Prince of Yiyang Yang had crime, submitted to execution.

units.zh: 丁亥，大赦。
units.en: On the dinghai day a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: Day dinghai, great amnesty.

units.zh: 時兵火之後，宮闕灰燼，以建平園爲宮。
units.en: After the fighting and fires the palace lay in ruins, so the court set up residence in the Jianping Garden.
units.literal: At time after weapons fire, palace gates ashes, used Jianping Garden as palace.

units.zh: 甲午，蘇逸以萬餘人自延陵湖將入吳興。
units.en: On the jiawu day Su Yi led more than ten thousand men from Lake Yanling toward Wuxing.
units.literal: Day jiawu, Su Yi with more than ten thousand from Yanling Lake was about to enter Wuxing.

units.zh: 乙未，將軍王允之及逸戰于溧陽，獲之。
units.en: On the yiwei day Wang Yunzhi overtook Su Yi at Liyang and took him prisoner.
units.literal: Day yiwei, General Wang Yunzhi and Yi battled at Liyang, captured him.

units.zh: 壬寅，以湘州幷荊州。
units.en: On the renyin day Xiangzhou was abolished and annexed to Jingzhou.
units.literal: Day renyin, took Xiangzhou merged into Jingzhou.

units.zh: 劉曜太子毗與其大司馬劉胤帥百官奔於上邽，關中大亂。
units.en: Liu Yao's crown prince Pi fled to Shanggui with Grand Marshal Liu Yin and the whole court in train, and chaos swept the Guanzhong heartland.
units.literal: Liu Yao's heir apparent Pi together with his Grand Marshal Liu Yin led the hundred officials in flight to Shanggui, and Guanzhong fell into great disorder.

units.zh: 三月壬子，以征西大將軍陶侃爲太尉，封長沙郡公；
units.en: On the renzi day of the third month Tao Kan, grand general who conquers the west, was appointed grand commandant and created duke of Changsha.
units.literal: Third month, day renzi, the General Who Conquers the West, Grand General Tao Kan, was made Grand Commandant and enfeoffed as duke of Changsha commandery;

units.zh: 車騎將軍郗鑒爲司空，封南昌縣公；
units.en: Xi Jian, general of chariots and cavalry, was named minister of works and enfeoffed as duke of Nanchang county.
units.literal: Chariots and Cavalry General Xi Jian was made Minister of Works and enfeoffed as duke of Nanchang county;

units.zh: 平南將軍溫嶠爲驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司，封始安郡公。
units.en: Wen Qiao, general who pacifies the south, was promoted to general of agile cavalry with full ministerial household privileges and created duke of Shian.
units.literal: General Who Pacifies the South Wen Qiao was made General of Agile Cavalry, with a household establishment equal to the Three Excellencies, and enfeoffed as duke of Shian commandery.

units.zh: 其餘封拜各有差。
units.en: The other titles and appointments were distributed in graded fashion.
units.literal: The remaining enfeoffments and appointments each had their gradations.

units.zh: 庚午，以右光祿大夫陸曄爲衛將軍、開府儀同三司，復封高密王紘爲彭城王。
units.en: On the gengwu day Lu Ye, right grand master of splendid carriage, became general of the guard with ministerial household rank, and Prince Hong of Gaomi was restored to the Pengcheng princedom.
units.literal: Day gengwu, Right Grand Master of Splendid Carriage Lu Ye was made General of the Guard, with household equal to the Three Excellencies, and Prince Hong of Gaomi was again enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng.

units.zh: 以護軍將軍庾亮爲平西將軍、都督揚州之宣城江西諸軍事、假節，領豫州刺史，鎮蕪湖。
units.en: Yu Liang, guard general, was named general who pacifies the west, area commander for Xuancheng and the Jiangxi sector of Yangzhou, granted the credential staff, and placed in charge of Yuzhou from his headquarters at Wuhu.
units.literal: Guard General Yu Liang was made General Who Pacifies the West, area commander for military affairs of Xuancheng and the lands west of the Yangzi within Yangzhou, given credential staff, concurrent Inspector of Yuzhou, and garrisoned at Wuhu.

units.zh: 夏四月乙未，驃騎將軍、始安公溫嶠卒。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer, on the yiwei day, Wen Qiao, general of agile cavalry and duke of Shian, died.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yiwei, General of Agile Cavalry, Duke of Shian Wen Qiao died.

units.zh: 秋七月，有星孛于西北。
units.en: A comet appeared in the northwest during the seventh month of autumn.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, there was a broom star in the northwest.

units.zh: 會稽、吳興、宣城、丹陽大水。
units.en: Severe flooding struck Kuaiji, Wuxing, Xuancheng, and Danyang.
units.literal: Kuaiji, Wuxing, Xuancheng, and Danyang had great floods.

units.zh: 詔復遭賊郡縣租稅三年。
units.en: The court ordered a three-year remission of taxes for every district that had been ravaged by the rebels.
units.literal: An edict remitted three years of rent and tax for commanderies and counties that had suffered bandits.

units.zh: 八月，利曜將劉胤等帥衆侵石生，次于雍。
units.en: In the eighth month Liu Yao's generals, led by Liu Yin, marched against Shi Sheng and encamped at Yong; the received graph wrongly writes Liu Yao's surname as li instead of Liu.
units.literal: Eighth month, Liu Yao's generals Liu Yin and others led troops to invade Shi Sheng and halted at Yong (the received surname graph is a corruption of Liu).

units.zh: 九月，石勒將石季龍擊胤，斬之，進屠上邽，盡滅劉氏，坑其黨三千餘人。
units.en: In the ninth month Shi Hu, Shi Le's general, defeated and executed Liu Yin, stormed Shanggui, extirpated the Liu royal house, and executed more than three thousand of their followers in a mass burial.
units.literal: Ninth month, Shi Le's general Shi Jilong struck Yin, beheaded him, advanced and slaughtered Shanggui, completely extinguished the Liu clan, and buried alive their faction of more than three thousand.

units.zh: 冬十月，廬山崩。
units.en: Mount Lu suffered a landslide in the tenth month of winter.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Mount Lu collapsed.

units.zh: 十二月壬辰，右將軍郭默害平南將軍、江州刺史劉胤，太尉陶侃帥衆討默。
units.en: On the renchen day of the twelfth month Guo Mo, right general, assassinated Liu Yin, general who pacifies the south and inspector of Jiangzhou. Tao Kan, grand commandant, then marched against him.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day renchen, Right General Guo Mo murdered General Who Pacifies the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou Liu Yin; Grand Commandant Tao Kan led troops to punish Mo.

units.zh: 是歲，天裂西北。
units.en: That year witnesses reported a fissure-like apparition in the northwestern sky.
units.literal: This year, heaven split in the northwest.

units.zh: 五年春正月己亥，大赦。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the fifth year of Xianhe, on the jihai day, the emperor proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day jihai, great amnesty.

units.zh: 癸亥，詔除諸將任子。
units.en: On the guihai day an edict ended the practice by which generals' sons held sinecure posts as hostages.
units.literal: Day guihai, an edict abolished the various generals' hereditary hostage-son appointments.

units.zh: 二月，以尚書陸玩爲尚書左僕射，孔愉爲右僕射。
units.en: In the second month Lu Wan of the Masters of Writing was promoted to left vice director and Kong Yu to right vice director.
units.literal: Second month, Masters of Writing Lu Wan was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, and Kong Yu was made Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 夏五月，旱，且饑疫。
units.en: The fifth month of summer brought drought together with famine and epidemic disease.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, drought, moreover famine and pestilence.

units.zh: 乙卯，太尉陶侃擒郭默于尋陽，斬之。
units.en: On the yimao day Tao Kan, grand commandant, seized Guo Mo at Xunyang and had him executed.
units.literal: Day yimao, Grand Commandant Tao Kan captured Guo Mo at Xunyang and beheaded him.

units.zh: 石勒將劉徵寇南沙，都尉許儒遇害，進入海虞。
units.en: Liu Zheng, a general of Shi Le, struck Nansha, killed Commandant Xu Ru, and pushed on into Haiyu.
units.literal: Shi Le's general Liu Zheng raided Nansha; Commandant Xu Ru met harm; he advanced and entered Haiyu.

units.zh: 六月癸巳，初稅田，畝三升。
units.en: On the guisi day of the sixth month the state began collecting field tax at the rate of three sheng of grain per mu.
units.literal: Sixth month, day guisi, fields were taxed for the first time, three sheng per mu.

units.zh: 秋八月，石勒僭卽皇帝位，使其將郭敬寇襄陽。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn Shi Le usurped the imperial throne and dispatched Guo Jing against Xiangyang.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, Shi Le usurpously assumed the imperial throne and sent his general Guo Jing to raid Xiangyang.

units.zh: 南中郎將周撫退歸武昌，中州流人悉降於勒。
units.en: Zhou Fu, South Gentlemen of the Household General, fell back to Wuchang, and the refugees from the central plains submitted en masse to Shi Le.
units.literal: South Gentlemen of the Household General Zhou Fu retreated and returned to Wuchang; displaced people of the Central Plain all surrendered to Le.

units.zh: 郭敬遂寇襄陽，屯于樊城。
units.en: Guo Jing pressed the attack on Xiangyang and fortified Fancheng on the opposite bank.
units.literal: Guo Jing then raided Xiangyang and encamped at Fancheng.

units.zh: 九月，造新宮，始繕苑城。
units.en: In the ninth month work began on a new palace complex and on restoring the imperial park walls.
units.literal: Ninth month, they built a new palace and began repairing the Yuan walled park.

units.zh: 甲辰，徒樂成王欽爲河間王，封彭城王紘子浚爲高密王。
units.en: On the jiachen day Prince Qin of Lecheng was transferred to the Hejian title, while Jun, son of Prince Hong of Pengcheng, was created prince of Gaomi.
units.literal: Day jiachen, Prince of Lecheng Qin was moved to be Prince of Hejian, and the son of Prince of Pengcheng Hong, Jun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaomi.

units.zh: 冬十月丁丑，幸司徒王導第，置酒大會。
units.en: On the dingchou day of the tenth month the sovereign visited Wang Dao's mansion, where a banquet was laid for a large gathering of officials.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingchou, the emperor visited Minister of Education Wang Dao's residence, set out wine, and held a great assembly.

units.zh: 李雄將李壽寇巴東、建平，監軍毌丘奧、太守楊謙退歸宜都。
units.en: Li Shou, a general under Li Xiong, struck Badong and Jianping, forcing army supervisor Wuqiu Ao and Prefect Yang Qian to withdraw to Yidu.
units.literal: Li Xiong's general Li Shou raided Badong and Jianping; Army Supervisor Wuqiu Ao and Administrator Yang Qian retreated and returned to Yidu.

units.zh: 十二月，張駿稱臣于石勒。
units.en: In the twelfth month Zhang Jun acknowledged Shi Le as overlord.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Zhang Jun declared himself subject to Shi Le.

units.zh: 六年春正月癸巳，劉徵復寇婁縣，遂掠武進。
units.en: On the guisi day of the first month in the sixth year of Xianhe, Liu Zheng raided Lou county again and swept on to pillage Wujin.
units.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day guisi, Liu Zheng again raided Lou county, then plundered Wujin.

units.zh: 乙未，進司空郗鑒都督吳國諸軍事。
units.en: On the yiwei day Xi Jian, minister of works, was additionally named area commander for all forces in the Wu region.
units.literal: Day yiwei, Minister of Works Xi Jian was advanced to area commander of all military affairs of the Wu region.

units.zh: 戊午，以運漕不繼，發王公已下千餘丁，各運米六斛。
units.en: On the wuwu day the grain barges fell behind schedule, so the court drafted over a thousand men from the princely houses on down, each to haul six hu of rice.
units.literal: Day wuwu, because transport of grain by water did not continue, more than a thousand laborers from kings and dukes downward were mobilized, each to transport six hu of rice.

units.zh: 二月己丑，以幽州刺史、大單于段遼爲驃騎將軍。
units.en: On the jichou day of the second month Duan Liao, inspector of Youzhou and grand chanyu of the Xianbei Duan, was appointed general of agile cavalry.
units.literal: Second month, day jichou, Inspector of Youzhou, Grand Chanyu Duan Liao was made General of Agile Cavalry.

units.zh: 三月壬戌朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: The new moon on renxu in the third month was marked by a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Third month, first day renxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 癸未，詔舉賢良直言之士。
units.en: On the guiwei day the throne called for nominations of worthy men willing to speak plain truth to power.
units.literal: Day guiwei, an edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and good men who speak straightforwardly.

units.zh: 夏四月，旱。
units.en: Drought persisted through the fourth month of summer.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, drought.

units.zh: 六月丙申，復故河間王顒爵位，封彭城王植子融爲樂成王，章武王混子珍爲章武王。
units.en: On the bingshen day of the sixth month Sima Yong's princely rank as prince of Hejian was posthumously restored. Rong, son of Prince Zhi of Pengcheng, was created prince of Lecheng, and Zhen, son of Prince Hun of Zhangwu, succeeded to the Zhangwu title.
units.literal: Sixth month, day bingshen, the former Prince of Hejian Yong's noble rank was restored; the son of Prince of Pengcheng Zhi, Rong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Lecheng; the son of Prince of Zhangwu Hun, Zhen, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhangwu.

units.zh: 秋七月，李雄將李壽侵陰平，武都氐帥楊難敵降之。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Li Shou pushed into Yinping, where Yang Nandi, Di chieftain of Wudu, submitted to him.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Li Xiong's general Li Shou invaded Yinping, and Wudu Di chieftain Yang Nandi surrendered to him.

units.zh: 八月庚子，以左僕射陸玩爲尚書令。
units.en: On the gengzi day of the eighth month Lu Wan, left vice director, was elevated to director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Eighth month, day gengzi, Left Vice Director Lu Wan was made Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 七年春正月辛未，大赦。
units.en: On the xinwei day of the first month in the seventh year of Xianhe the court issued a general amnesty.
units.literal: Seventh year, spring, first month, day xinwei, great amnesty.

units.zh: 三月，西中郎將趙胤、司徒中郎匡術攻石勒馬頭塢，克之。
units.en: In the third month Zhao Yin, West Gentlemen of the Household General, and Kuang Shu, a staff gentleman of the minister of education, stormed Shi Le's riverside stronghold at Matou and took it.
units.literal: Third month, West Gentlemen of the Household General Zhao Yin and Minister of Education Gentlemen Kuang Shu attacked Shi Le's Matou fort and overcame it.

units.zh: 勒將韓雍寇南沙及海虞。
units.en: Han Yong, one of Shi Le's generals, raided Nansha and Haiyu.
units.literal: Le's general Han Yong raided Nansha and Haiyu.

units.zh: 夏四月，勒將郭敬陷襄陽。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Guo Jing, serving Shi Le, seized Xiangyang.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Le's general Guo Jing captured Xiangyang.

units.zh: 五月，大水。
units.en: The fifth month brought widespread flooding.
units.literal: Fifth month, great flood.

units.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔諸養獸之屬，損費者多，一切除之。
units.en: On the bingchen day of the seventh month an edict abolished every costly palace menagerie and similar extravagance.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen, an edict said of all categories of raising beasts, those who waste expense much, entirely remove them.

units.zh: 太尉陶侃遣子平西參軍斌與南中郎將桓宣攻石勒將郭敬，破之，克樊城。
units.en: Tao Kan, grand commandant, sent his son Tao Bin, an adviser on the staff of the general who pacifies the west, and Huan Xuan, South Gentlemen of the Household General, against Guo Jing. They broke his army and took Fancheng.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Tao Kan sent his son, Army Adviser Who Pacifies the West Bin, and South Gentlemen of the Household General Huan Xuan to attack Shi Le's general Guo Jing, defeated him, and captured Fancheng.

units.zh: 竟陵太守李陽拔新野、襄陽，因而戍之。
units.en: Li Yang, administrator of Jingling, recovered Xinye and Xiangyang and left troops to hold them.
units.literal: Administrator of Jingling Li Yang uprooted Xinye and Xiangyang, thereby garrisoning them.

units.zh: 冬十一月壬子朔，進太尉陶侃爲大將軍。
units.en: At the new moon on renzi in the eleventh month Tao Kan was promoted from grand commandant to grand general.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, first day renzi, Grand Commandant Tao Kan was advanced to Grand General.

units.zh: 詔舉賢良。
units.en: The court again called for recommendations of worthy men of integrity.
units.literal: An edict ordered the recommendation of worthy and good men.

units.zh: 十二月庚戌，帝遷于新宮。
units.en: On the gengxu day of the twelfth month the emperor took up residence in the new palace.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day gengxu, the emperor moved to the new palace.

units.zh: 八年春正月辛亥朔，詔曰：「昔犬賊縱暴，宮室焚蕩，元惡雖翦，未暇營築。
units.en: At the new moon on xinhai in the first month of the eighth year of Xianhe an edict declared, "When the rebel dogs ran wild they burned the palace to the ground; though the ringleaders have been cut off, there has been no leisure to rebuild.
units.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, first day xinhai, an edict said, "Formerly dog bandits indulged violence; palace chambers were burned and destroyed; although the chief evil was cut, there was no leisure to build and construct.

units.zh: 有司屢陳，朝會逼狹，遂作斯宮，子來之勞，不日而成。
units.en: Ministers kept reporting that court audiences had grown intolerably cramped, so this hall was raised; the people rallied to the work, and it rose in what seemed no time at all.
units.literal: Officials repeatedly stated that court meetings were cramped and narrow; therefore this palace was made; the labor of 'the sons came,' in not a day it was completed.

units.zh: 旣獲臨御，大饗羣后，九賓充誕，百官象物。
units.en: Now that the throne can hold court here, we have feasted the lords, received the envoys in full array, and marshaled the hundred officials according to their emblems.
units.literal: Having obtained to attend and rule, a great feast for the various lords; the nine guests filled and extended; the hundred officials embodied their things.

units.zh: 知君子勤禮，小人盡力矣。
units.en: It is plain that gentlemen have kept the rites while commoners have given their utmost.
units.literal: Know that gentlemen are diligent in rites and petty men have exhausted their strength.

units.zh: 思蠲密綱，咸同斯惠，其赦五歲刑以下。」
units.en: We would loosen the harsh net of the law and share this grace with all: let sentences of five years or less be remitted."
units.literal: Think to remove the dense net; all alike share this favor; shall amnesty punishments of five years and below."

units.zh: 令諸郡舉力人能舉千五百斤以上者。
units.en: In addition, every commandery shall nominate men of proven strength who can lift more than fifteen hundred jin.
units.literal: An edict ordered the various commanderies to recommend strong men able to lift more than one thousand five hundred jin.

units.zh: 丙寅，李雄將李壽陷寧州，刺史尹奉及建寧太守霍彪並降之。
units.en: On the bingyin day Li Shou overran Ningzhou; Yin Feng, the inspector, and Huo Biao, prefect of Jianning, capitulated with him.
units.literal: Day bingyin, Li Xiong's general Li Shou captured Ningzhou; Inspector Yin Feng and Jianning Administrator Huo Biao together surrendered to him.

units.zh: 癸酉，以張駿爲鎮西大將軍。
units.en: On the guiyou day Zhang Jun was appointed grand general who guards the west.
units.literal: Day guiyou, Zhang Jun was made General Who Guards the West, Grand General.

units.zh: 丙子，石勒遣使致賂，詔焚之。
units.en: On the bingzi day Shi Le sent gifts in an attempt to buy favor; the court ordered the bribes burned in public.
units.literal: Day bingzi, Shi Le sent an envoy to deliver bribes; an edict ordered them burned.

units.zh: 夏四月，詔封故新蔡王弼弟邈爲新蔡王。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer an edict created Sima Miao, younger brother of the late Prince Bi of Xincai, as the new prince of Xincai.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, an edict enfeoffed the former Prince of Xincai Bi's younger brother Miao as Prince of Xincai.

units.zh: 以束帛徵處士尋陽翟湯、會稽虞喜。
units.en: The court summoned the recluses Zhai Tang of Xunyang and Yu Xi of Kuaiji with gifts of silk.
units.literal: With bundles of silk summoned recluses Zhai Tang of Xunyang and Yu Xi of Kuaiji.

units.zh: 五月，有星隕于肥鄉。
units.en: A meteor streaked down over Feixiang in the fifth month.
units.literal: Fifth month, there was a star that fell at Feixiang.

units.zh: 麒麟、騶虞見于遼東。
units.en: A qilin and a zouyu, auspicious beasts, were reported in Liaodong.
units.literal: Qilin and zouyu appeared in Liaodong.

units.zh: 乙未，車騎將軍、遼東公慕容廆卒，子皝嗣位。
units.en: On the yiwei day Murong Hui, general of chariots and cavalry and duke of Liaodong, died; his heir Murong Huang succeeded him.
units.literal: Day yiwei, Chariots and Cavalry General, Duke of Liaodong Murong Hui died; his son Huang succeeded the position.

units.zh: 六月甲辰，撫軍將軍王舒卒。
units.en: On the jiachen day of the sixth month Wang Shu, general who comforts the army, died.
units.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen, General Who Comforts the Army Wang Shu died.

units.zh: 秋七月戊辰，石勒死，子弘嗣偽位，其將石聰以譙來降。
units.en: On the wuchen day of the seventh month Shi Le died. His son Shi Hong inherited the false throne, while general Shi Cong brought the district of Qiao over to Jin.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen, Shi Le died; his son Hong succeeded the false throne; his general Shi Cong with Qiao came to surrender.

units.zh: 冬十月，石弘將石生起兵于關中，稱秦州刺史，遣使來降。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Shi Sheng rose in Guanzhong in the name of inspector of Qinzhou and sent envoys offering submission to Jin.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Shi Hong's general Shi Sheng raised troops in Guanzhong, styled himself Inspector of Qinzhou, and sent an envoy to come surrender.

units.zh: 石弘將石季龍攻石朗于洛陽，因進擊石生，俱滅之。
units.en: Shi Hu marched on Shi Lang at Luoyang, then turned on Shi Sheng and destroyed them both.
units.literal: Shi Hong's general Shi Jilong attacked Shi Lang at Luoyang, thereby advanced and struck Shi Sheng, together extinguished them.

units.zh: 十二月，石生故部將郭權遣使請降。
units.en: In the twelfth month Guo Quan, a former officer of Shi Sheng, sent word asking to defect to Jin.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Shi Sheng's former subordinate general Guo Quan sent an envoy requesting surrender.

units.zh: 九年春正月，隕石于涼州二。
units.en: Early in the ninth year two meteorites fell in Liangzhou.
units.literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, meteorites at Liangzhou two.

units.zh: 以郭權爲鎮西將軍、雍州刺史。
units.en: Guo Quan was named general who guards the west and inspector of Yongzhou.
units.literal: Guo Quan was made General Who Guards the West and Inspector of Yongzhou.

units.zh: 二月丁卯，加鎮西大將軍張駿爲大將軍。
units.en: On the dingmao day of the second month Zhang Jun, grand general who guards the west, received the additional title of grand general.
units.literal: Second month, day dingmao, added General Who Guards the West Grand General Zhang Jun as Grand General.

units.zh: 三月丁酉，會稽地震。
units.en: An earthquake shook Kuaiji on the dingyou day of the third month.
units.literal: Third month, day dingyou, Kuaiji earthquake.

units.zh: 夏四月，石弘將石季龍使石斌攻郭權于郿，陷之。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Shi Hong's general Shi Hu sent Shi Bin against Guo Quan at Mei and captured the town.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Shi Hong's general Shi Jilong sent Shi Bin to attack Guo Quan at Mei and captured it.

units.zh: 六月，李雄死，其兄子班嗣偽位。
units.en: Li Xiong died in the sixth month, and his nephew Ban succeeded him on the Cheng throne.
units.literal: Sixth month, Li Xiong died; his elder brother's son Ban succeeded the false throne.

units.zh: 乙卯，太尉、長沙公陶侃薨。
units.en: On the yimao day Tao Kan, grand commandant and duke of Changsha, died.
units.literal: Day yimao, Grand Commandant, Duke of Changsha Tao Kan died.

units.zh: 大旱，詔太官撤膳，省刑，恤孤寡，貶費節用。
units.en: Amid severe drought the court ordered simpler imperial meals, lighter punishments, relief for widows and orphans, and strict cuts to palace spending.
units.literal: Great drought; an edict ordered the Grand Provisioner to remove meals, reduce punishments, pity orphans and widows, cut expenses and moderate use.

units.zh: 辛末，加平西將軍庾亮都督江、荊、豫、益、梁、雍六州諸軍事。
units.en: On the xinwei day Yu Liang, general who pacifies the west, was placed in overall command of military affairs across Jiang, Jing, Yu, Yi, Liang, and Yong.
units.literal: Day xinwei, added General Who Pacifies the West Yu Liang as area commander of military affairs of the six provinces Jiang, Jing, Yu, Yi, Liang, and Yong.

units.zh: 秋八月，大雩。
units.en: The court held the great rain sacrifice in the eighth month of autumn.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, great rain prayer.

units.zh: 自五月不雨，至于是月。
units.en: Not a drop had fallen since the fifth month down to this one.
units.literal: From the fifth month there was no rain until this month.

units.zh: 九月戊寅，散騎常侍，衛將軍、江陵公陸曄卒。
units.en: On the wuyin day of the ninth month Lu Ye, cavalier attendant-in-ordinary, general of the guard, and duke of Jiangling, died.
units.literal: Ninth month, day wuyin, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, General of the Guard, Duke of Jiangling Lu Ye died.

units.zh: 冬十月，李雄子期弑李班而自立，班弟玝與其將焦會、羅凱等並來降。
units.en: In the tenth month Li Qi murdered his cousin Li Ban and seized the throne. Ban's brother Li Wu fled to Jin with Jiao Hui, Luo Kai, and other officers.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Li Xiong's son Qi assassinated Li Ban and established himself; Ban's younger brother Wu together with his generals Jiao Hui, Luo Kai, and others together came to surrender.

units.zh: 十一月，石季龍弑石弘，自立爲天王。
units.en: In the eleventh month Shi Hu murdered Shi Hong and established himself as Heavenly King.
units.literal: Eleventh month, Shi Jilong assassinated Shi Hong and established himself as Heavenly King.

units.zh: 十二月丁卯，以東海王沖爲車騎將軍，琅邪王岳爲驃騎將軍。
units.en: On the dingmao day of the twelfth month Prince Chong of Donghai was named general of chariots and cavalry and Prince Yue of Langye general of agile cavalry.
units.literal: Twelfth month, day dingmao, Prince of Donghai Chong was made Chariots and Cavalry General, Prince of Langye Yue was made General of Agile Cavalry.

units.zh: 蘭陵人朱縱斬石季龍將郭祥，以彭城來降。
units.en: Zhu Zong of Lanling slew Guo Xiang, one of Shi Hu's generals, and brought Pengcheng over to Jin.
units.literal: Lanling man Zhu Zong beheaded Shi Jilong's general Guo Xiang and with Pengcheng came to surrender.

units.zh: 咸康元年春正月庚午朔，帝加元服，大赦，改元，增文武位一等，大酺三日，賜鰥寡孤獨不能自存者米，人五斛。
units.en: At the new moon on gengwu in the first month of the Xiankang era the emperor came of age. He proclaimed a general amnesty, adopted the new reign title, promoted officials by one rank, ordered three days of public feasting, and gave five hu of grain to every indigent widower, widow, orphan, or solitary without kin.
units.literal: Xiankang first year, spring, first month, first day gengwu, the emperor added capping robes, great amnesty, changed era name, increased civil and military ranks one grade, great feast three days, granted rice to widowers, widows, orphans, and solitary who could not preserve themselves, five hu per person.

units.zh: 二月甲子，帝親釋奠。
units.en: On the jiazi day of the second month the emperor personally performed the libation offering.
units.literal: Second month, day jiazi, the emperor personally performed the libation offering.

units.zh: 揚州諸郡饑，遣使振給。
units.en: Famine gripped the commanderies of Yangzhou, and the court dispatched officials with relief grain.
units.literal: Yangzhou's various commanderies had famine; envoys were sent to relieve and supply.

units.zh: 三月乙酉，幸司徒府。
units.en: On the yiyou day of the third month the emperor called at the minister of education's yamen.
units.literal: Third month, day yiyou, the emperor visited the Minister of Education's office.

units.zh: 夏四月癸卯，石季龍寇歷陽，加司徒王導大司馬、假黃鉞、都督征討諸軍事，以禦之。
units.en: When Shi Hu struck Liyang in the fourth month of summer, Wang Dao was named grand marshal, given the yellow battle-ax, and placed in supreme command of the armies raised to meet him.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guimao, Shi Jilong raided Liyang; Minister of Education Wang Dao was added Grand Marshal, yellow battle-ax, area commander of all punitive campaign military affairs, in order to resist him.

units.zh: 癸丑，帝觀兵于廣莫門，分命諸將，遣將軍劉仕救歷陽，平西將軍趙胤屯慈湖，龍驤將軍路永戍牛渚，建武將軍王允之戍蕪湖。
units.en: On the guichou day the sovereign reviewed the host at Guangmo Gate and issued dispositions: Liu Shi was sent to relieve Liyang, Zhao Yin to hold Cihu, Lu Yong to guard Niuzhu, and Wang Yunzhi to secure Wuhu.
units.literal: Day guichou, the emperor reviewed troops at Guangmo Gate, separately ordered various generals, sent General Liu Shi to relieve Liyang, General Who Pacifies the West Zhao Yin to encamp at Cihu, Soaring Dragon General Lu Yong to garrison Niuzhu, General Who Establishes Might Wang Yunzhi to garrison Wuhu.

units.zh: 司空郗鑒使廣陵相陳光帥衆衛京師，賊退向襄陽。
units.en: Xi Jian, minister of works, ordered Chen Guang of Guangling to march on the capital as a screen, and the invaders drew back toward Xiangyang.
units.literal: Minister of Works Xi Jian ordered Chancellor of Guangling Chen Guang to lead troops to guard the capital; the bandits retreated toward Xiangyang.

units.zh: 戊午，解嚴。
units.en: On the wuwu day the capital stood down from full mobilization.
units.literal: Day wuwu, martial law was lifted.

units.zh: 石季龍將石遇寇中廬，南中郎將王國退保襄陽。
units.en: Shi Yu, serving Shi Hu, struck Zhonglu, and Wang Guo, South Gentlemen of the Household General, fell back to defend Xiangyang.
units.literal: Shi Jilong's general Shi Yu raided Zhonglu; South Gentlemen of the Household General Wang Guo retreated to protect Xiangyang.

units.zh: 秋八月，長沙、武陵大水。
units.en: Changsha and Wuling were inundated in the eighth month of autumn.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, Changsha and Wuling had great floods.

units.zh: 束帛徵處士翟湯、郭翻。
units.en: The court again summoned the recluses Zhai Tang and Guo Fan with bundles of silk.
units.literal: With silks summoned recluses Zhai Tang and Guo Fan.

units.zh: 冬十月乙未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: A solar eclipse occurred on the new moon of yiwei in the tenth month of winter.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, first day yiwei, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 是歲，大旱，會稽餘姚尤甚，米斗五百價，人相賣。
units.en: That year the drought was catastrophic; Yuyao in Kuaiji was hardest hit, grain sold for five hundred cash a peck, and people sold one another into slavery.
units.literal: This year, great drought, Kuaiji's Yuyao especially severe, rice dou five hundred in price, people mutually sold.

units.zh: 二年春正月辛巳，彗星見于奎。
units.en: On the xinsi day of the first month in the second year of Xiankang a comet appeared in the Kui asterism.
units.literal: Second year, spring, first month, day xinsi, a broom star appeared in Kui.

units.zh: 以吳國內史虞潭爲衛將軍。
units.en: Yu Tan, interior secretary of the Wu princedom, was appointed general of the guard.
units.literal: Interior Secretary of the Wu princedom Yu Tan was made General of the Guard.

units.zh: 二月，算軍用稅米，空懸五十餘萬石，尚書謝褒巳下免官。
units.en: In the second month an audit of grain levied for military use revealed a shortfall of over half a million shi on the books. Xie Bao of the Masters of Writing and every official beneath him in the chain was dismissed.
units.literal: Second month, reckoning military-use tax rice, empty suspended more than five hundred thousand shi; from Masters of Writing Xie Bao downward, dismissed from office.

units.zh: 辛亥，立皇后杜氏，大赦，增文武位一等。
units.en: On the xinhai day Lady Du was invested as empress. The court proclaimed a general amnesty and raised civil and military ranks by one step.
units.literal: Day xinhai, established Empress Du, great amnesty, increased civil and military ranks one grade.

units.zh: 庚申，高句驪遣使貢方物。
units.en: On the gengshen day envoys from Goguryeo arrived with tribute of regional goods.
units.literal: Day gengshen, Goguryeo sent envoys to offer local products.

units.zh: 三月，旱，詔太官減膳，免所旱郡縣繇役。
units.en: Drought lingered into the third month, so the court ordered simpler palace meals and remitted labor service in every district that the drought had struck.
units.literal: Third month, drought; an edict ordered the Grand Provisioner to reduce meals, remitted corvée in drought-stricken commanderies and counties.

units.zh: 戊寅，大雩。
units.en: On the wuyin day the court held the great rain sacrifice.
units.literal: Day wuyin, great rain prayer.

units.zh: 夏四月丁巳，皇后見于太廟。
units.en: On the dingsi day of the fourth month of summer the empress was presented to the imperial ancestors in the Grand Temple.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingsi, the empress appeared at the Grand Temple.

units.zh: 雨雹。
units.en: Hailstorms swept the capital region.
units.literal: Rain hail.

units.zh: 秋七月，揚州會稽饑，開倉振給。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn famine struck Kuaiji in Yangzhou, and the government opened its granaries for relief.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Yangzhou's Kuaiji had famine; granaries were opened to relieve and supply.

units.zh: 冬十月，廣州刺史鄧嶽遣督護王隨擊夜郎，新昌太守陶協擊興古，並克之。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Deng Yue, inspector of Guangzhou, dispatched Wang Sui against Yelang and Tao Xie, prefect of Xinchang, against Xinggu; both campaigns succeeded.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Inspector of Guangzhou Deng Yue sent Supervisor Wang Sui to strike Yelang, Xinchang Administrator Tao Xie to strike Xinggu, together overcame them.

units.zh: 詔曰：「歷觀先代，莫不褒崇明祀，賓禮三恪。
units.en: An edict declared, "In every past dynasty wise rulers honored the great sacrifices and received the three reverent houses of fallen dynasties as honored guests.
units.literal: An edict stated, "Looking through successive ages, none failed to exalt the great sacrifices and to receive the three reverent houses of fallen dynasties as honored guests.

units.zh: 故杞宋啓土，光于周典；
units.en: Thus the houses of Qi and Song received their fiefs and shone in the canonical rites of Zhou.
units.literal: Therefore Qi and Song opened territory, shone in Zhou's canons;

units.zh: 宗姬侯衛，垂美漢冊。
units.en: The cadet branches of the Ji surname were enfeoffed as Wei, a grace recorded in splendor on the Han rolls.
units.literal: Zong Ji marquises guarded Wei, hung beauty on Han's registers.

units.zh: 自頃喪亂，庶邦殄悴，周漢之後，絕而莫繼。
units.en: In recent generations of turmoil countless states have perished, and the lines that should continue Zhou and Han have been broken with no heirs.
units.literal: Since recently mourning and chaos, many states perished and withered; Zhou and Han's posterity, cut off and none continued.

units.zh: 其祥求衛公、山陽公近屬，有履行修明，可以繼承其祀者，依舊典施行。」
units.en: Let ministers search out close kin of the dukes of Wei and Shanyang whose conduct is proven and who can maintain their ancestral rites, then invest them according to precedent."
units.literal: Carefully seek near kin of the dukes of Wei and Shanyang whose conduct is proven and who can maintain their ancestral rites, then invest them according to precedent."

units.zh: 新作朱雀浮桁。
units.en: A new floating bridge was built at the Vermilion Bird gate.
units.literal: Newly made Vermilion Bird floating bridge.

units.zh: 十一月，遣建威將軍司馬勳安集漢中，爲李期將李壽所敗。
units.en: In the eleventh month Sima Xun, general who establishes might, was sent to pacify Hanzhong but was routed by Li Shou, a general serving Li Qi of Cheng.
units.literal: Eleventh month, sent General Who Establishes Might Sima Xun to pacify and gather Hanzhong, was defeated by Li Qi's general Li Shou.

units.zh: 三年春正月辛卯，立太學。
units.en: On the xinmao day of the first month in the third year of Xiankang the Imperial University was founded.
units.literal: Third year, spring, first month, day xinmao, established the Imperial University.

units.zh: 夏六月，旱。
units.en: The sixth month of summer brought another drought.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, drought.

units.zh: 冬十一月丁卯，慕容皝自立爲燕王。
units.en: On the dingmao day of the eleventh month Murong Huang declared himself king of Yan.
units.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day dingmao, Murong Huang independently established himself as Yan King.

units.zh: 四年春二月，石季龍帥衆七萬，擊段遼于遼西，遼奔于平崗。
units.en: In the second month of spring in the fourth year of Xiankang, Shi Hu marched seventy thousand men against Duan Liao in Liaoxi and drove him to take refuge at Pinggang.
units.literal: Fourth year, spring, second month, Shi Jilong led crowd seventy thousand, struck Duan Liao in Liaoxi, Liao fled to Pinggang.

units.zh: 夏四月，李壽弑李期。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Li Shou murdered Li Qi of Cheng.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Li Shou assassinated Li Qi.

units.zh: 僭卽偽位，國號漢。
units.en: He then seized the throne in usurpation and renamed the state Han.
units.literal: Usurpously assumed false throne, state title Han.

units.zh: 石季龍爲慕容皝所敗，癸丑，加皝征北大將軍。
units.en: After Shi Hu suffered defeat at Murong Huang's hands, Murong Huang was on the guichou day promoted to grand general who conquers the north.
units.literal: Shi Jilong was by Murong Huang defeated; day guichou, added Huang General Who Conquers the North, Grand General.

units.zh: 五月乙未，以司徒王導爲太傅、都督中外諸軍事，司空郗鑒爲太尉，征西將軍庾亮爲司空。
units.en: On the yiwei day of the fifth month Wang Dao became grand tutor and supreme area commander, Xi Jian was elevated from minister of works to grand commandant, and Yu Liang, general who conquers the west, succeeded Xi Jian as minister of works.
units.literal: Fifth month, day yiwei, Minister of Education Wang Dao was made Grand Tutor, area commander of all central and outer military affairs; Minister of Works Xi Jian was made Grand Commandant; General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 六月，改司徒爲丞相，乙太傅王導爲之。
units.en: In the sixth month the office of minister of education was retitled chancellor, and Grand Tutor Wang Dao was appointed to the post.
units.literal: Sixth month, changed Minister of Education to Chancellor, and took Grand Tutor Wang Dao to fill it.

units.zh: 秋八月丙午，分寧州置安州。
units.en: On the bingwu day of the eighth month part of Ningzhou was split off to form a new Anzhou.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day bingwu, divided Ningzhou and established Anzhou.

units.zh: 五年春正月辛丑，大赦。
units.en: On the xinchou day of the first month in the fifth year of Xiankang the throne proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, day xinchou, great amnesty.

units.zh: 三月乙丑，廣州刺史鄧嶽伐蜀，建寧人孟彥執李壽將霍彪以降。
units.en: On the yichou day of the third month Deng Yue of Guangzhou invaded Shu, where Meng Yan of Jianning captured Huo Biao, a general of Li Shou, and surrendered him to Jin.
units.literal: Third month, day yichou, Inspector of Guangzhou Deng Yue campaigned against Shu; Jianning man Meng Yan seized Li Shou's general Huo Biao in order to surrender.

units.zh: 夏四月辛未，征西將軍庾亮遣參軍趙松擊巴郡、江陽，獲石季龍將李閎、黃桓等。
units.en: On the xinwei day of the fourth month Yu Liang sent Zhao Song against Ba and Jiangyang and took prisoner Li Hong, Huang Huan, and other officers of Shi Hu.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day xinwei, General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang sent Army Adviser Zhao Song to strike Ba commandery and Jiangyang, captured Shi Jilong's generals Li Hong, Huang Huan, and others.

units.zh: 秋七月庚申，使持節、侍中、丞相、領揚州刺史、始興公王導薨。
units.en: On the gengshen day of the seventh month Wang Dao, duke of Shixing—credential-bearing palace attendant, chancellor, and inspector of Yangzhou—died.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day gengshen, Bearer of the Staff of Authority, Palace Attendant, Chancellor, concurrent Inspector of Yangzhou, Duke of Shixing Wang Dao died.

units.zh: 辛酉，以護軍將軍何充錄尚書事。
units.en: On the xinyou day He Chong, guard general, was placed in charge of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Day xinyou, Guard General He Chong was made to record Masters of Writing affairs.

units.zh: 八月壬午，復改丞相爲司徒。
units.en: On the renwu day of the eighth month the title of chancellor was abolished and the old office of minister of education restored.
units.literal: Eighth month, day renwu, again changed Chancellor to Minister of Education.

units.zh: 辛酉，太尉、南昌公郗鑒薨。
units.en: On the xinyou day Xi Jian, grand commandant and duke of Nanchang, died.
units.literal: Day xinyou, Grand Commandant, Duke of Nanchang Xi Jian died.

units.zh: 九月，石季龍將夔安、李農陷沔南，張貉陷邾城，因寇江夏、義陽，征虜將軍毛寶、西陽太守樊俊、義陽太守鄭進並死之。
units.en: In the ninth month Kui An and Li Nong, generals of Shi Hu, overran the country south of the Han River while Zhang He took Zhu city and pushed into Jiangxia and Yiyang. Mao Bao, general who conquers the caitiffs, Fan Jun of Xiyang, and Zheng Jin of Yiyang all fell in the fighting.
units.literal: Ninth month, Shi Jilong's generals Kui An, Li Nong captured south of the Mian, Zhang He captured Zhu city, thereby raided Jiangxia and Yiyang; General Who Conquers the Caitiffs Mao Bao, Administrator of Xiyang Fan Jun, Administrator of Yiyang Zheng Jin together died in it.

units.zh: 夔安等進圍石城，竟陵太守李陽距戰，破之，斬首五千餘級。
units.en: Kui An then besieged Shicheng, but Li Yang, administrator of Jingling, gave battle, broke the siege, and took more than five thousand heads.
units.literal: Kui An and others advanced and besieged Stone City; Administrator of Jingling Li Yang resisted in battle, defeated them, beheaded more than five thousand heads.

units.zh: 安乃退，遂略漢東，擁七千餘家遷于幽冀。
units.en: Kui An withdrew but swept through the country east of the Han, deporting more than seven thousand households to the You and Ji regions.
units.literal: An then retreated, then plundered east of the Han, embracing more than seven thousand households moved to You and Ji.

units.zh: 冬十二月丙戌，以驃騎將軍、琅邪王岳爲司徒。
units.en: On the bingxu day of the twelfth month Prince Yue of Langye, general of agile cavalry, was named minister of education.
units.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day bingxu, General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Langye Yue was made Minister of Education.

units.zh: 李壽將李奕寇巴東，守將勞揚戰敗，死之。
units.en: Li Yi, a general under Li Shou, struck Badong and killed Lao Yang, the defending commander, in defeat.
units.literal: Li Shou's general Li Yi raided Badong; defending general Lao Yang was defeated in battle, died in it.

units.zh: 六年春正月庚子，使持節、都督江豫益梁雍交廣七州諸軍事、司空、都亭侯庾亮薨。
units.en: On the gengzi day of the first month in the sixth year of Xiankang Yu Liang, marquis of Duting—minister of works and area commander for seven provinces from the Yangzi to the south—passed away.
units.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, day gengzi, Bearer of the Staff of Authority, area commander of military affairs of the seven provinces Jiang, Yu, Yi, Liang, Yong, Jiao, and Guang, Minister of Works, Marquis of Duting Yu Liang died.

units.zh: 辛亥，以左光祿大夫陸玩爲司空。
units.en: On the xinhai day Lu Wan, left grand master of splendid carriage, was appointed minister of works.
units.literal: Day xinhai, Left Grand Master of Splendid Carriage Lu Wan was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 二月，慕容皝及石季龍將石成戰于遼西，敗之，獻捷于京師。
units.en: In the second month Murong Huang defeated Shi Cheng, one of Shi Hu's generals, in Liaoxi and sent news of the victory to the capital.
units.literal: Second month, Murong Huang and Shi Jilong's general Shi Cheng battled in Liaoxi, defeated him, presented victory to the capital.

units.zh: 庚辰，有星孛于太微。
units.en: On the gengchen day a comet appeared in the Supreme Tenuity asterism.
units.literal: Day gengchen, there was a broom star in Supreme Tenuity.

units.zh: 三月丁卯，大赦。
units.en: On the dingmao day of the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: Third month, day dingmao, great amnesty.

units.zh: 以車騎將軍、東海王沖爲驃騎將軍。
units.en: Prince Chong of Donghai, general of chariots and cavalry, was promoted to general of agile cavalry.
units.literal: Chariots and Cavalry General, Prince of Donghai Chong was made General of Agile Cavalry.

units.zh: 李壽陷丹川，守將孟彥、劉齊、李秋皆死之。
units.en: Li Shou overran Danchuan, where Meng Yan, Liu Qi, and Li Qiu, the defenders, were all killed.
units.literal: Li Shou captured Danchuan; defending generals Meng Yan, Liu Qi, Li Qiu all died in it.

units.zh: 秋七月乙卯，初依中興故事，朔望聽政于東堂。
units.en: On the yimao day of the seventh month the court revived Eastern Jin practice: on each new and full moon the sovereign would hold court in the East Hall.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yimao, first according to Restoration precedent, new and full moons heard government at East Hall.

units.zh: 冬十月，林邑獻馴象。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter the kingdom of Linyi sent trained elephants as tribute.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, Linyi presented tame elephants.

units.zh: 十一月癸卯，復琅邪，比漢豐沛。
units.en: On the guimao day of the eleventh month the Langye princedom was granted privileges comparable to the Han dynasty's honors for Feng and Pei.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day guimao, restored Langye, compared to Han's Feng and Pei.

units.zh: 七年春二月甲子朔，日有蝕之，己卯，慕容皝遣使求假燕王章璽，許之。
units.en: The new moon on jiazi in the second month brought a solar eclipse. On the jimao day Murong Huang's envoys asked for the regalia of king of Yan, and the court assented.
units.literal: Seventh year, spring, second month, first day jiazi, there was an eclipse of the sun; jimao, Murong Huang sent envoys requesting borrowed Yan King seals and tallies, permitted it.

units.zh: 三月戊戌，杜皇后崩。
units.en: On the wuxu day of the third month Empress Du died.
units.literal: Third month, day wuxu, Empress Du died.

units.zh: 夏四月丁卯。
units.en: The fourth month of summer opened on the dingmao day.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingmao.

units.zh: 葬恭皇后于興平陵。
units.en: Empress Gong was interred at the Xingping mausoleum.
units.literal: Buried Empress Gong at Xingping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 實編戶，王公已下皆正土斷白籍。
units.en: The census was tightened so that every household from princes on down was registered under the regular commandery system and the anomalous white-register status was abolished.
units.literal: Solidify registered households; from kings and dukes downward all rectified earth-cut white registers.

units.zh: 秋八月辛酉，驃騎將軍、東海王沖薨。
units.en: On the xinyou day of the eighth month Prince Chong of Donghai, general of agile cavalry, died.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day xinyou, General of Agile Cavalry, Prince of Donghai Chong died.

units.zh: 九月，罷太僕官。
units.en: In the ninth month the office of grand coachman was suppressed.
units.literal: Ninth month, abolished Grand Coachman office.

units.zh: 冬十二月癸酉，司空、興平伯陸玩薨。
units.en: On the guiyou day of the twelfth month Lu Wan, minister of works and baron of Xingping, died.
units.literal: Winter, twelfth month, day guiyou, Minister of Works, Baron of Xingping Lu Wan died.

units.zh: 除樂府雜伎。
units.en: The court dismissed the variety performers of the imperial music bureau.
units.literal: Removed Music Bureau miscellaneous entertainers.

units.zh: 罷安州。
units.en: The province of Anzhou was abolished.
units.literal: Abolished Anzhou.

units.zh: 八年春正月己未朔，日有蝕之。
units.en: A solar eclipse marked the new moon on jiwei in the first month of the eighth year of Xiankang.
units.literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, first day jiwei, there was an eclipse of the sun.

units.zh: 乙丑，大赦。
units.en: On the yichou day a general amnesty was issued.
units.literal: Day yichou, great amnesty.

units.zh: 三月，初以武悼楊皇后配饗武帝廟。
units.en: In the third month the Wudao Empress Yang was for the first time given joint offerings in Emperor Wu's temple.
units.literal: Third month, first took Martial Lament Empress Yang to accompany in sacrifice at Emperor Wu's temple.

units.zh: 夏六月庚寅，帝不豫，詔曰：「朕以眇年，獲嗣洪緒，託于王公之上，于茲十有八年。
units.en: On the gengyin day of the sixth month of summer the emperor fell seriously ill. His edict read, "I came to the throne in childhood and have now borne the great mandate above the lords of the realm for eighteen years.
units.literal: Summer, sixth month, day gengyin, the emperor was unwell; an edict stated, "I, with small years, had inherited the great continuation, been entrusted above kings and dukes, and reigned now eighteen years.

units.zh: 未能闡融政道。
units.en: Yet I have never fully brought lucid harmony to government.
units.literal: Was not able to clarify and harmonize the way of government.

units.zh: 翦除逋昆，夙夜戰兢，匪遑寧處。
units.en: While rebels still lurked I trembled day and night and knew no peace.
units.literal: Cutting and removing fugitive rebels, morning and night trembling with fear, not leisurely peaceful dwelling.

units.zh: 今遘疾殆不興，是用震悼于厥心。
units.en: Now sickness grips me and I may not recover; my heart is stricken with dread.
units.literal: Now encountering illness probably not rising, therefore with shock grief in that heart.

units.zh: 千齡眇眇，未堪艱難。
units.en: The heir is still a child and cannot yet bear the weight of crisis.
units.literal: Thousand years tiny tiny, not able to bear hardship and difficulty.

units.zh: 司徒、琅邪王岳，親則母弟，體則仁長，君人之風，允塞時望。
units.en: Prince Yue of Langye, minister of education, is my younger brother by the same mother, mature in kindness, with the bearing of a true ruler, and he commands the confidence of the age.
units.literal: Minister of Education, Prince of Langye Yue, in kinship then younger brother by the same mother, in substance then benevolent and senior, lord-of-men's air, truly fills the age's hope.

units.zh: 肆爾王公卿士，其輔之！
units.en: Therefore you princes, dukes, and ministers: support him with all your strength.
units.literal: Therefore you kings, dukes, ministers and gentlemen, shall assist him!

units.zh: 以祗奉祖宗明祀，協和內外，允執其中。
units.en: Let him reverently maintain the sacrifices to our forebears, bring harmony within and without, and hold fast the golden mean.
units.literal: In order reverently to serve ancestors' bright sacrifices, harmonize inside and outside, sincerely hold the middle.

units.zh: 嗚呼，敬之哉！
units.en: Alas, revere this charge.
units.literal: Alas, revere this!

units.zh: 無墜祖宗之顯命。」
units.en: Do not betray the glorious mandate our ancestors have handed down."
units.literal: Do not drop the ancestors' manifest mandate."

units.zh: 壬辰，引武陵王晞、會稽王昱、中書監庾冰、中書令何充、尚書令諸葛恢並受顧命。
units.en: On the renchen day Prince Xi of Wuling, Prince Yu of Kuaiji, Yu Bing as palace secretariat supervisor, He Chong as palace secretariat director, and Zhuge Hui as director of the Masters of Writing were summoned to receive the dying emperor's testament.
units.literal: Day renchen, Prince of Wuling Xi, Prince of Kuaiji Yu, Palace Secretariat Supervisor Yu Bing, Palace Secretariat Director He Chong, and Director of the Masters of Writing Zhuge Hui were led in together to receive the testamentary charge.

units.zh: 癸巳，帝崩于西堂，時年二十二，葬興平陵，廟號顯宗。
