units.en: On the guisi day he died in the West Hall at the age of twenty-two. He was buried at the Xingping mausoleum with the temple name Xianzong.
units.literal: Day guisi, the emperor died in West Hall, at the time age twenty-two, buried at Xingping Mausoleum, temple name Xianzong.

units.zh: 帝少而聰敏，有成人之量。
units.en: From boyhood he was quick and perceptive, with the composure of a grown man.
units.literal: The emperor in youth was clever and keen, had an adult's capacity.

units.zh: 南頓王宗之誅也，帝不之知，及蘇峻平，問庾亮曰：「常曰白頭公何在？」
units.en: He had known nothing of the execution of Prince Zong of Nandun. After Su Jun fell he asked Yu Liang, "Where is the white-haired lord who was always spoken of?"
units.literal: When Prince of Nandun Zong was executed, the emperor did not know of it; when Su Jun was pacified, he asked Yu Liang, "Where is the white-haired old man whom he had often been told about?"

units.zh: 亮對以謀反伏誅，帝泣謂亮曰：「舅言人作賊，便殺之，人言舅作賊，復若何？」
units.en: Yu Liang answered that Prince Zong had been executed for treason. The emperor wept and said to Yu Liang, "When you say a man is a rebel you kill him at once. If men say you are a rebel, what then?"
units.literal: Liang answered that Zong had plotted rebellion and been executed; the emperor wept and said to Liang, "When the uncle says people are bandits he kills them at once; if people say the uncle is a bandit, what then?"

units.zh: 亮懼，變色。
units.en: Yu Liang turned pale with fear.
units.literal: Liang feared and changed color.

units.zh: 庾懌嘗送酒於江州刺史王允之，允之與犬，犬斃，懼而表之。
units.en: Yu Yi once sent wine to Wang Yunzhi, inspector of Jiangzhou. Wang Yunzhi fed it to a dog, which died; he then memorialized the throne in alarm.
units.literal: Yu Yi once sent wine to Inspector of Jiangzhou Wang Yunzhi; Yunzhi gave it to a dog, the dog died; in fear he memorialized it.

units.zh: 帝怒曰：「大舅已亂天下，小舅復欲爾邪？」
units.en: The emperor raged, "Your elder uncle has already brought chaos on the realm. Would your younger uncle do the same?"
units.literal: The emperor angrily said, "The great uncle has already disordered the realm; would the younger uncle wish to do the same?"

units.zh: 懌聞，飲藥而死。
units.en: When Yu Yi heard this he took poison and died.
units.literal: Yi heard, drank poison and died.

units.zh: 然少爲舅氏所制，不親庶政。
units.en: In his youth he was dominated by his uncles on his mother's side and did not personally handle routine administration.
units.literal: Yet in youth was by maternal uncles' clan controlled, did not personally attend to various government.

units.zh: 及長，頗留心萬機，務在簡約，常欲于後園作射堂，計用四十金，以勞費乃止。
units.en: Once grown he took a closer interest in state affairs and insisted on frugality. He once planned an archery hall in the rear garden until the estimate came to forty jin of gold, whereupon he dropped the project as too costly.
units.literal: When grown, somewhat attended to the myriad pivots, aimed at simplicity and restraint; constantly wished in rear garden to make archery hall, reckoned to use forty jin of gold, because labor expense then stopped.

units.zh: 雄武之度，雖有愧于前王；
units.en: In heroic vigor he perhaps fell short of earlier sovereigns;
units.literal: Heroic martial measure, although had shame before former kings;

units.zh: 恭儉之德，足追蹤于住烈矣。
units.en: In reverent thrift he could stand beside the finest exemplars of the past; the received text miswrites the verb go as dwell.
units.literal: Respectful frugal virtue, enough to trace footsteps of past ardor.

units.zh: 康皇帝諱岳，字世同，成帝母弟也。
units.en: Emperor Kang, personal name Yue, courtesy name Shitong, was Emperor Cheng's full younger brother.
units.literal: Emperor Kang's taboo name was Yue, courtesy name Shitong, and he was Emperor Cheng's younger brother by the same mother.

units.zh: 咸和元年封吳王，二年徙封琅邪王；
units.en: In the first year of Xianhe he was created prince of Wu and in the second was transferred to the Langye princedom.
units.literal: Xianhe first year enfeoffed Prince of Wu, second year moved enfeoffment to Prince of Langye;

units.zh: 九年拜散騎常侍，加驃騎將軍，咸康五年遷侍中、司徒。
units.en: In the ninth year of Xianhe he became cavalier attendant-in-ordinary and general of agile cavalry, and in the fifth year of Xiankang he rose to palace attendant and minister of education.
units.literal: Ninth year appointed Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, added General of Agile Cavalry; Xiankang fifth year moved to Palace Attendant, Minister of Education.

units.zh: 八年六月庚寅，成帝不悆，詔以琅邪王爲嗣。
units.en: On the gengyin day of the sixth month in the eighth year of Xiankang Emperor Cheng fell mortally ill and named the prince of Langye as successor.
units.literal: Eighth year, sixth month, day gengyin, Emperor Cheng was not recovered; an edict took Prince of Langye as heir.

units.zh: 癸巳，成帝崩。
units.en: On the guisi day Emperor Cheng died.
units.literal: Day guisi, Emperor Cheng died.

units.zh: 甲午，卽皇帝位，大赦。
units.en: On the jiawu day he ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: Day jiawu, assumed imperial throne, great amnesty.

units.zh: 諸屯戍文武及二千石官長，不得輒離所局而來奔赴。
units.en: Civil and military officers at frontier posts and every prefect ranked at two thousand piculs were forbidden to abandon their commands and rush to the capital.
units.literal: All garrison civil and military and two-thousand-shi office chiefs, must not rashly leave their posts and come to hasten to attend.

units.zh: 己亥，封成帝子丕爲琅邪王，奕爲東海王。
units.en: On the jihai day Emperor Cheng's sons Pi and Yi were created princes of Langye and Donghai respectively.
units.literal: Day jihai, enfeoffed Emperor Cheng's son Pi as Prince of Langye, Yi as Prince of Donghai.

units.zh: 時帝諒陰不言，委政于庾冰、何充。
units.en: The new sovereign observed mourning silence and left affairs to Yu Bing and He Chong.
units.literal: At the time the emperor in mourning shed did not speak, entrusted government to Yu Bing, He Chong.

units.zh: 秋七月丙辰，葬成皇帝于興平陵。
units.en: On the bingchen day of the seventh month Emperor Cheng was laid to rest at the Xingping mausoleum.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingchen, buried Emperor Cheng at Xingping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 帝親奉奠于西階，旣發引，徒行至閶闔門，升素輿，至于陵所。
units.en: The emperor himself offered libations on the west steps, then walked behind the bier to the Changhe gate, boarded an unadorned cart, and accompanied the cortège to the tomb.
units.literal: The emperor personally carried libation at west steps; when the pulling began, walked on foot to Changhe Gate, ascended plain carriage, arrived at mausoleum place.

units.zh: 己未，以中書令何充爲驃騎將軍。
units.en: On the jiwei day He Chong, palace secretariat director, was named general of agile cavalry.
units.literal: Day jiwei, Palace Secretariat Director He Chong was made General of Agile Cavalry.

units.zh: 八月辛丑，彭城王紘薨。
units.en: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Prince Hong of Pengcheng died.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on xinchou, Hong, Prince of Pengcheng, died.

units.zh: 以江州刺史王允之爲衛將軍。
units.en: Wang Yunzhi, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was appointed Guards General.
units.literal: Wang Yunzhi, Inspector of Jiangzhou, was made Guards General.

units.zh: 九月，詔琅邪國及府史進位各有差。
units.en: In the ninth month an edict rewarded the household and staff of the Langye princedom with graded promotions.
units.literal: Ninth month, an edict ordered Langye princedom and mansion clerks' advancement in rank each had gradations.

units.zh: 冬十月甲午，衛將軍王允之卒。
units.en: On the jiawu day of the tenth month Wang Yunzhi, general of the guard, died.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day jiawu, General of the Guard Wang Yunzhi died.

units.zh: 十二月，增文武位二等。
units.en: In the twelfth month civil and military officials were promoted by two ranks.
units.literal: Twelfth month, increased civil and military ranks two grades.

units.zh: 壬子，立皇后褚氏。
units.en: On the renzi day Lady Chu was invested as empress.
units.literal: Day renzi, established Empress Chu.

units.zh: 建元元年春正月，改元，振恤鰥寡孤獨。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the first year of the Jianyuan era the reign title was changed and relief was extended to widowers, widows, orphans, and those without kin.
units.literal: Jianyuan first year, spring, first month, changed era name, relieved and pitied widowers, widows, orphans, and solitary.

units.zh: 三月，以中書監庾冰爲車騎將軍。
units.en: In the third month Yu Bing, palace secretariat supervisor, was appointed general of chariots and cavalry.
units.literal: Third month, Palace Secretariat Supervisor Yu Bing was made Chariots and Cavalry General.

units.zh: 夏四月，益州刺史周撫、西陽太守曹據伐李壽，敗其將恆于江陽。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Zhou Fu, inspector of Yizhou, and Cao Ju, prefect of Xiyang, attacked Li Shou and routed his general Heng at Jiangyang.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, Inspector of Yizhou Zhou Fu and Administrator of Xiyang Cao Ju campaigned against Li Shou, defeated his general Heng at Jiangyang.

units.zh: 五月，旱。
units.en: The fifth month brought drought again.
units.literal: Fifth month, drought.

units.zh: 六月壬午，又以束帛徵處士尋陽翟湯、會稽虞喜。
units.en: On the renwu day of the sixth month the court once more summoned Zhai Tang of Xunyang and Yu Xi of Kuaiji with gifts of silk.
units.literal: Sixth month, day renwu, again with bundles of silk summoned recluses Zhai Tang of Xunyang and Yu Xi of Kuaiji.

units.zh: 有司奏，成帝崩一周，請改素服，御進膳如舊。
units.en: The ministry reported that the first anniversary of Emperor Cheng's death had come and asked that mourning dress give way and the sovereign resume normal meals.
units.literal: Officials memorialized that Emperor Cheng had died one cycle, requested to change plain garments, imperial advance meals as before.

units.zh: 壬寅，詔曰：「禮之降殺，因時而寢興，誠無常矣。
units.en: On the renyin day an edict declared, "The gradations of ritual wax and wane with the times and are never fixed.
units.literal: Day renyin, an edict stated, "The gradations of ritual wax and wane with the times and are never fixed in themselves.

units.zh: 至于君親相准，名教之重，莫之改也。
units.en: Yet the parity owed to sovereign and parent, the weight of moral teaching, admits no arbitrary change.
units.literal: As for ruler and kin mutually measuring, the weight of name-teaching, nothing changes it.

units.zh: 權制之作，蓋出近代，雖曰適事，實弊薄之始。
units.en: Expedient rules are a recent innovation. Though they suit the moment, they are the first step toward shallow custom.
units.literal: Expedient regulations' making, generally issued from recent generations, although called suiting affairs, are really the beginning of decay and thinness.

units.zh: 先王崇之，後世猶怠，而況因循，又從輕降，義弗可矣。」
units.en: The ancient kings prized these norms, yet later ages grew slack. To drift along now and further ease the rites would violate right principle."
units.literal: Former kings exalted them, later generations still were lax, how much more following along, again following light lowering, righteousness cannot approve."

units.zh: 石季龍帥衆伐慕容皝，皝大敗之。
units.en: Shi Hu marched against Murong Huang and was crushingly defeated.
units.literal: Shi Jilong led troops to attack Murong Huang; Huang greatly defeated him.

units.zh: 秋七月，石季龍將戴開帥衆來降。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Dai Kai, a general of Shi Hu, brought his command over to Jin.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, Shi Jilong's general Dai Kai led troops to come surrender.

units.zh: 丁巳，詔曰：「慕容皝摧殄羯寇，乃云死沒八萬餘人，將是其天亡之始也。
units.en: On the dingsi day an edict noted, "Murong Huang has shattered the Jie host with losses put at more than eighty thousand, perhaps the first sign that Heaven was turning against them.
units.literal: Day dingsi, an edict stated, "Murong Huang had destroyed the Jie bandits with losses said to exceed eighty thousand, perhaps the first sign of Heaven turning against them.

units.zh: 中原之事，宜加籌量。
units.en: Affairs in the Central Plain should be weighed with care.
units.literal: Central Plain's affairs, ought to add calculation and measure.

units.zh: 且戴開已帥部黨歸順，宜見慰勞。
units.en: Moreover Dai Kai has already defected with his following and deserves imperial commendation.
units.literal: Moreover Dai Kai already led faction and party to submit, ought to be seen and consoled.

units.zh: 其遣使詣安西、驃騎，咨謀諸軍事。」
units.en: Let envoys be sent to the general who pacifies the west and the general of agile cavalry to concert all military measures."
units.literal: Shall send envoys to visit General Who Pacifies the West and General of Agile Cavalry, consult and plan various military affairs."

units.zh: 以輔國將軍、琅邪內史桓溫爲前鋒小督、假節，帥衆入臨淮，安西將軍庾翼爲征討大都督，遷鎮襄陽。
units.en: Huan Wen, general who supports the state and interior secretary of Langye, was named junior van commander, given the credential staff, and ordered into Linhuai with his troops. Yu Yi, general who pacifies the west, became grand campaign commander-in-chief and shifted his headquarters to Xiangyang.
units.literal: General Who Supports the State, Interior Secretary of Langye Huan Wen was made Junior Van Commander of the Van, given credential staff, led troops into Linhuai; General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi was made Grand Area Commander for Punitive Campaigns, moved garrison to Xiangyang.

units.zh: 庚申，晉陵、吳郡災。
units.en: On the gengshen day fire or storm disaster struck Jinling and Wu commandery.
units.literal: Day gengshen, Jinling and Wu Commandery had disaster.

units.zh: 八月，李壽死，子勢嗣偽位。
units.en: In the eighth month Li Shou died and his son Li Shi inherited the Cheng throne.
units.literal: Eighth month, Li Shou died; his son Shi succeeded false throne.

units.zh: 石季龍使其將劉寧攻陷狄道。
units.en: Shi Hu sent Liu Ning to take Didao.
units.literal: Shi Jilong sent his general Liu Ning to attack and capture Didao.

units.zh: 冬十月辛巳，以車騎將軍庾冰都督荊江司雍益梁六州諸軍事、江州刺史，以驃騎將軍何充爲中書監、都督揚豫二州諸軍事、揚州刺史、錄尚書事，輔政。
units.en: On the xinsi day of the tenth month Yu Bing, general of chariots and cavalry, was named area commander for Jing, Jiang, Si, Yong, Yi, and Liang and inspector of Jiangzhou. He Chong, general of agile cavalry, became palace secretariat supervisor, area commander for Yang and Yu, inspector of Yangzhou, overseer of the Masters of Writing, and regent.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinsi, Chariots and Cavalry General Yu Bing was made area commander of military affairs of the six provinces Jing, Jiang, Si, Yong, Yi, and Liang, Inspector of Jiangzhou; General of Agile Cavalry He Chong was made Palace Secretariat Supervisor, area commander of military affairs of the two provinces Yang and Yu, Inspector of Yangzhou, recorded Masters of Writing affairs, assisted government.

units.zh: 以琅邪內史桓溫都督青徐兗三州諸軍事、徐州刺史，褚裒爲衛將軍、領中書令。
units.en: Huan Wen was placed in command of Qing, Xu, and Yan and given Xuzhou as inspector. Chu Ai was named general of the guard and acting palace secretariat director.
units.literal: Interior Secretary of Langye Huan Wen was made area commander of military affairs of the three provinces Qing, Xu, and Yan, Inspector of Xuzhou; Chu Ai was made General of the Guard, concurrent Palace Secretariat Director.

units.zh: 十一月己巳，大赦。
units.en: On the jisi day of the eleventh month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
units.literal: Eleventh month, day jisi, great amnesty.

units.zh: 十二月，石季龍侵張駿，駿使其將軍謝艾拒之，大戰于河西，季龍敗績。
units.en: In the twelfth month Shi Hu invaded Zhang Jun, who sent Xie Ai to meet him. They fought west of the Yellow River and Shi Hu was routed.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Shi Jilong invaded Zhang Jun; Jun sent his general Xie Ai to resist him, great battle west of the river, Jilong was greatly defeated.

units.zh: 十二月，高句驪遣使朝獻。
units.en: That same twelfth month Goguryeo sent tribute envoys to court.
units.literal: Twelfth month, Goguryeo sent envoys to court with offerings.

units.zh: 二年春正月，張駿遣其將和驎、謝艾討南羌于闐和，大破之。
units.en: In the first month of spring in the second year of Jianyuan, Zhang Jun dispatched He Lin and Xie Ai against the Southern Qiang at Tianhe and shattered them.
units.literal: Second year, spring, first month, Zhang Jun sent his generals He Lin, Xie Ai to punish Southern Qiang at Khotan He, greatly broke them.

units.zh: 二月，慕容皝及鮮卑帥宇文歸戰于昌黎，歸衆大敗，奔于漠北。
units.en: In the second month Murong Huang fought the Xianbei chieftain Yuwen Gui at Changli, broke his army, and drove him into the northern steppe.
units.literal: Second month, Murong Huang and Xianbei commander Yuwen Gui battled at Changli; Gui's crowd was greatly defeated, fled to desert north.

units.zh: 四月，張駿將張瓘敗石季龍將王擢于三交城。
units.en: In the fourth month Zhang Guan, serving Zhang Jun, defeated Shi Hu's general Wang Zhuo at Sanjiao city.
units.literal: Fourth month, Zhang Jun's general Zhang Guan defeated Shi Jilong's general Wang Zhuo at Three Junctions City.

units.zh: 秋八月丙子，進安西將軍庾翼爲征西將軍。
units.en: On the bingzi day of the eighth month Yu Yi was promoted from general who pacifies the west to general who conquers the west.
units.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day bingzi, advanced General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi to General Who Conquers the West.

units.zh: 庚辰，持節、都督司雍梁三州諸軍事、梁州刺史、平北將軍、竟陵公桓宣卒。
units.en: On the gengchen day Huan Xuan, duke of Jingling—credential-bearing area commander for Si, Yong, and Liang, inspector of Liangzhou, and general who pacifies the north—died.
units.literal: Day gengchen, Staff-holder, area commander of military affairs of the three provinces Si, Yong, and Liang, Inspector of Liangzhou, General Who Pacifies the North, Duke of Jingling Huan Xuan died.

units.zh: 丁巳，以衛將軍褚裒爲特進、都督徐兗二州諸軍事、兗州刺史，鎮金城。
units.en: On the dingsi day Chu Ai, general of the guard, was given specially advanced rank, command over Xu and Yan, the inspectorship of Yanzhou, and a garrison at Jincheng.
units.literal: Day dingsi, General of the Guard Chu Ai was made specially advanced, area commander of military affairs of the two provinces Xu and Yan, Inspector of Yanzhou, garrisoned Jincheng.

units.zh: 九月，巴東太守楊謙擊李勢將申陽，走之，獲其將樂高。
units.en: In the ninth month Yang Qian, prefect of Badong, attacked Shen Yang, a general of Li Shi, drove him off, and took Yue Gao prisoner.
units.literal: Ninth month, Administrator of Badong Yang Qian struck Li Shi's general Shen Yang, routed him, captured his general Yue Gao.

units.zh: 丙申，立皇子聃爲皇太子。
units.en: On the bingshen day the emperor's son Sima Dan was invested as crown prince.
units.literal: Day bingshen, established imperial son Dan as heir apparent.

units.zh: 戊戌，帝崩于式乾殿。
units.en: On the wuxu day Emperor Kang died in the Shiqian Hall.
units.literal: Day wuxu, the emperor died in Shiqian Hall.

units.zh: 時年二十三，葬崇平陵。
units.en: He was twenty-three. He was buried at the Chongping mausoleum.
units.literal: At the time age twenty-three, buried at Chongping Mausoleum.

units.zh: 初，成帝有疾，中書令庾冰自以舅氏當朝，權侔人主，恐異世之後，戚屬將疏，乃言國有強敵，宜立長君，遂以帝爲嗣。
units.en: Earlier, when Emperor Cheng fell ill, Yu Bing, palace secretariat director, knew that as maternal uncle he dominated the court with power rivaling the throne. Fearing that in another generation his kin would lose influence, he argued that strong foes abroad required a mature sovereign and had Kang named heir.
units.literal: Initially, when Emperor Cheng was ill, Palace Secretariat Director Yu Bing, considering that as the maternal-uncle house he held the court and that his power equaled the sovereign's, feared that after a change of generations the affinal kin would be distanced; he then said the state had strong enemies and that a mature ruler ought to be established, and thereupon took the emperor as heir.

units.zh: 制度年號，再興中朝，因改元曰建元。
units.en: He framed a new reign title to signal a second restoration of the central court, hence the adoption of Jianyuan.
units.literal: Instituted era name, again raised central court, thereby changed era name called Jianyuan.

units.zh: 或謂冰曰：「郭璞讖云『立始之際丘山傾』，立者，建也；
units.en: Someone told Yu Bing that Guo Pu's prophecy read, "When establishment and beginning meet, 'the hills will crumble'; li stands for jian.
units.literal: Someone said to Bing that Guo Pu's prophecy read, "At the juncture of establishment and beginning, 'the hills will crumble'; establishment stands for the reign graph jian.

units.zh: 始者，元也；
units.en: Shi stands for the primary yuan.
units.literal: Shi means yuan;

units.zh: 丘山，諱也。」
units.en: Hills is a cryptic reference to the imperial taboo name Yue."
units.literal: Hills are taboo name."

units.zh: 冰瞿然，旣而歎曰：「如有吉凶，豈改易所能救乎？」
units.en: Yu Bing started, then sighed, "If doom is written, can we avert it by juggling words?"
units.literal: Bing was startled, then sighed, saying, "If there is fortune or misfortune, how could changing and altering save it?"

units.zh: 至是果驗云。
units.en: Events afterward proved the omen true.
units.literal: Arriving at this it indeed was verified, it is said.

units.zh: 史臣曰：肆虐滔天，豈伊朝夕。
units.en: The historians write that wanton rebellion rising to heaven is never the work of a single dawn or dusk.
units.literal: The historian says: Wanton violence flooding heaven, how is it only morning and evening.

units.zh: 若乃詳刑不怨，庶情猶仰，又可以見逆順之機焉。
units.en: When punishments are just and the people do not resent them, the multitude still looks upward to the throne, and one may read therein the hinge of loyalty and revolt.
units.literal: If then detailed punishments without resentment, multitude feelings still look up, again can thereby see rebellion and submission's pivot.

units.zh: 成帝因削弱之資，守江淮之地，政出渭陽，聲乖威服。
units.en: Emperor Cheng inherited a weakened realm and held the line along the Yangzi and Huai, yet policy issued from his uncles on the Wei bank while his prestige no longer matched awe and submission.
units.literal: Emperor Cheng relied on weakened resources, guarded Jiang and Huai lands, government issued from Weiyang, reputation deviated from awe-submission.

units.zh: 凶徒旣縱，神器阽危，京華元敖之資，宮室類咸陽之火。
units.en: Once the rebels ran free the throne tottered, the capital lacked any deep bulwark, and the palaces blazed like Xianyang in Qin's fall.
units.literal: Fierce bandits already unleashed, divine vessel on brink of peril, capital splendor lacked bulwark's resources, palace chambers resembled Xianyang's fire.

units.zh: 桀犬吠堯。
units.en: Jie's hounds barked at Yao himself.
units.literal: Jie's dog barks at Yao.

units.zh: 封狐嗣亂，方諸后羿，曷若斯之甚也。
units.en: The monstrous fox carried on the havoc; set beside the misrule of Hou Yi, which was worse?
units.literal: Great fox continues chaos, compare to Hou Yi, how like this so extreme.

units.zh: 反我皇駕，不有晉文之師，繫于苞桑，且賴陶公之力。
units.en: The imperial carriage was turned back; without hosts like those of Duke Wen of Jin, the dynasty, tethered to the mulberry roots, moreover relied on Lord Tao Kan's strength.
units.literal: Turned back our imperial carriage; without Jin Wen's hosts, tied to mulberry roots, moreover relied on Lord Tao's strength.

units.zh: 古之侯服，不幸臣家，天子宣游，則避宮北面，聞諸遺策，用爲恆範。
units.en: By ancient feudal etiquette a lord did not domineer over his minister's house. When the sovereign went abroad he vacated the palace and faced north; the old canons made that the standing rule.
units.literal: Ancient feudal service, not fortunate in minister's house; when Son of Heaven proclaimed tour, then avoided palace and faced north; heard in transmitted plans, used as constant norm.

units.zh: 顯宗于王導之門，斂衣前拜，豈魯公受玉之卑乎！
units.en: Emperor Xianzong gathered his robes and bowed deep at Wang Dao's gate; can that be read as mere humility like the Duke of Lu accepting the jade?
units.literal: Xianzong at Wang Dao's gate, gathered robes and bowed forward; was it Duke of Lu receiving jade's humility!

units.zh: 帝亦克儉于躬，庶能激揚流弊者也。
units.en: The sovereign was frugal in his own conduct and thus could strike against the drift of excess.
units.literal: The emperor also was able to be frugal in person, perhaps able to rouse and raise flowing abuses.

units.zh: 贊曰：惟皇夙表，余舅爲毗。
units.en: The encomium runs: The sovereign showed promise early while uncles on his mother's side stood as his pillars.
units.literal: Encomium says: Only the emperor early showed, my uncle was adjutant.

units.zh: 勤於致寇，拙於行師。
units.en: They were zealous in inviting enemies yet clumsy in leading armies.
units.literal: Diligent in bringing bandits, clumsy in moving troops.

units.zh: 火及君屋，兵纏帝帷。
units.en: Flames licked the ruler's hall and blades ringed the imperial bed-curtains.
units.literal: Fire reached ruler's house, weapons wound emperor's curtains.

units.zh: 石頭之駕，海內含悲。
units.en: The removal of the imperial carriage to Stone Fort wrung grief from the whole realm.
units.literal: Stone Fort's carriage, within the seas held grief.

units.zh: 康后天資，居哀禮縟。
units.en: Empress Dowager Kang was gifted by nature and observed mourning with the fullest rites.
units.literal: Kang empress dowager's heaven-bestowed substance, dwelling in mourning rites elaborate.

units.zh: 墜典方興，降齡奚促。
units.en: Fallen rites had barely been revived when his allotted years were cut short; why so soon?
units.literal: Fallen canons just rising, lowered span why hasty.
